in meaning it is conjoined to يبسط], and its i'rab is like it. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is omitted. ﴿بِعِبادِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خبيرا. ﴿خَبِيراً بَصِيراً﴾: two khabars of kāna. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَقْتُلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَوْلادَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَشْيَةَ﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿إِمْلاقٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿نَرْزُقُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَإِيَّاكُمْ﴾: an accusative pronoun conjoined to the object of نرزقهم. ﴿إِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ﴾: inna and its noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ خِطْأً﴾: kāna, and its noun is omitted, and خطئا is the khabar. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَقْرَبُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿الزِّنى﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete past verb, and its noun is omitted. ﴿فاحِشَةً﴾: the khabar of kāna. ﴿وَساءَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ساء is a past verb for expressing blame, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification).

daas-irab:33-35.t: ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَقْتُلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿النَّفْسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to تقتلوا. ﴿وَمَنْ قُتِلَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); and a passive past verb, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَظْلُوماً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَقَدْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لِوَلِيِّهِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun occupy the place of the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سُلْطاناً﴾: first mafʿūl bihi of جعلنا, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿يُسْرِفْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْقَتْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يسرف. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent. ﴿مَنْصُوراً﴾: its khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَلا تَقْرَبُوا مالَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, lā is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and ﴿مالَ﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْيَتِيمِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿بِالَّتِي﴾: a relative noun, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the two are attached to تقربوا. ﴿هِيَ أَحْسَنُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿يَبْلُغَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after حتى; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive, and the two are attached to تقربوا. ﴿أَشُدَّهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَوْفُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِالْعَهْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوفوا. ﴿إِنَّ الْعَهْدَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ مَسْؤُلًا﴾: inna [Translator's note: so in the source; read "kāna"] and its khabar, and its noun is omitted; the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَأَوْفُوا﴾: conjoined to أوفوا, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿الْكَيْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿كِلْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَزِنُوا﴾: conjoined to what preceded; it is an imperative verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِالْقِسْطاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to زنوا. ﴿الْمُسْتَقِيمِ﴾: an adjective. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address; it is mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: khabar, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَحْسَنُ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to خير. ﴿تَأْوِيلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification).

daas-irab:36-38.t: ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَقْفُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the weak letter, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾: the noun of laysa, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ السَّمْعَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤادَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes, and the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿كُلُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the kāf is for address; the clause كل etc. is the khabar of inna. ﴿كانَ عَنْهُ مَسْؤُلًا﴾: kāna and its khabar, and its noun is omitted; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar, and the clause is the khabar of كل. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَمْشِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by lā through the deletion of the weak letter, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تمش. ﴿مَرَحاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَنْ﴾: a particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿تَخْرِقَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَلَنْ تَبْلُغَ الْجِبالَ﴾: conjoined to the preceding one, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿طُولًا﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿كُلُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿كانَ سَيِّئُهُ﴾: kāna and its noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the khabar, and the clause is the khabar of كل. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿مَكْرُوهاً﴾: the khabar of kāna.

daas-irab:39-41.t: ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: mā is a relative noun; the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَوْحى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوحى. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنَ الْحِكْمَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوحى or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا تَجْعَلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, lā is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and its fāʿil is omitted; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَعَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to تجعل. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلهاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آخَرَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَتُلْقى﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted. ﴿فِي جَهَنَّمَ﴾: جهنم is a diptote, genitive (majrūr), its sign of the genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra; the two are attached to تلقى. ﴿مَلُوماً مَدْحُوراً﴾: two ḥāls. ﴿أَفَأَصْفاكُمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb and its fronted object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾: a postponed fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْبَنِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أصفاكم; it is genitive by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿وَاتَّخَذَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اتخذ. ﴿إِناثاً﴾: first mafʿūl bihi; as for its second object, it is من الملائكة. ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَتَقُولُونَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿قَوْلًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿عَظِيماً﴾: an adjective. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿صَرَّفْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿فِي هذَا﴾: the hā is for drawing attention, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to صرفنا. ﴿الْقُرْآنِ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿لِيَذَّكَّرُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an, through the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the lām and what follows it are attached to صرفنا. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is of the ḥāl, and mā is negative. ﴿يَزِيدُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is omitted, and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿نُفُوراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:42-44.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾: an adverb of place attached (mutaʿalliq) to the fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿آلِهَةٌ﴾: the noun of kāna, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition, and mā is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the kāf and what follows it are attached to the omitted khabar of kāna. ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of answer and requital. ﴿لَابْتَغَوْا﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of law, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two quiescents, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِلى ذِي﴾: ذي is genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns, and the two are attached to ابتغوا. ﴿الْعَرْشِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; it is a resumptive clause. ﴿وَتَعالى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿تَعالى﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: mā is a relative noun, and the two are attached to تعالى. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عُلُوًّا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿تُسَبِّحُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تسبح. ﴿السَّماواتُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿وَالْأَرْضُ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: a relative noun conjoined to what preceded, and it is in the position of the nominative. ﴿فِيهِنَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and in is negative. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿يُسَبِّحُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِحَمْدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يسبح, and the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿تَفْقَهُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَسْبِيحَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ حَلِيماً غَفُوراً﴾: kāna and its two khabars, and its noun is omitted; the clause is the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:45-46.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿قَرَأْتَ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْقُرْآنَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of إذا. ﴿بَيْنَكَ﴾: an adverb of place attached (mutaʿalliq) to جعلنا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبَيْنَ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the book calls such a clause the ṣila (relative clause)]. ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤمنون. ﴿حِجاباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مَسْتُوراً﴾: an adjective. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جعلنا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَكِنَّةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَفْقَهُوهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, its sign of the accusative being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "خشية أن" etc. ﴿وَفِي آذانِهِمْ وَقْراً﴾: conjoined to قلوبهم. ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿ذَكَرْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبَّكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْقُرْآنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ذكرت. ﴿وَحْدَهُ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَّوْا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two quiescents, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿عَلى أَدْبارِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ولوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نُفُوراً﴾: ḥāl or its mafʿūl li-ajlihi.

daas-irab:47-49.t: ﴿نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾: mā is a relative noun, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أعلم. ﴿يَسْتَمِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يستمعون. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached to أعلم. ﴿يَسْتَمِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يستمعون. ﴿وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوى﴾: إذ is an adverb conjoined to what precedes it, and mubtadaʾ and khabar, nominative by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb, badal (substitute) of the إذ before it. ﴿يَقُولُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a particle of negation. ﴿تَتَّبِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿رَجُلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مَسْحُوراً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿انْظُرْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ضَرَبُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ضربوا. ﴿الْأَمْثالَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَضَلُّوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فَلا﴾: lā is negative. ﴿يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَإِذا﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿كُنَّا عِظاماً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿وَرُفاتاً﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and inna, and نا is its noun, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the khabar is nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿خَلْقاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) or ḥāl. ﴿جَدِيداً﴾: an adjective, and the clause is emphatic (muʾakkida).

daas-irab:50-51.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كُونُوا﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperative verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿حِجارَةً﴾: the khabar (predicate) of كانوا [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb is كونوا], and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَوْ حَدِيداً﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to حجارة. ﴿أَوْ خَلْقاً﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: mā is a relative noun, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted adjective of خلقا. ﴿يَكْبُرُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي صُدُورِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يكبر, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَسَيَقُولُونَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿مَنْ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُعِيدُنا﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and نا is its object, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and its khabar is omitted; the clause is the speech reported. ﴿فَطَرَكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its object, its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَسَيُنْغِضُونَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينغضون. ﴿رُؤُسَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَتى﴾: an interrogative noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿هُوَ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the speech reported. ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَسى﴾: a past verb of hope (tarajjī), and its noun is omitted. ﴿أَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَكُونَ﴾: an imperfect incomplete verb whose noun is latent. ﴿قَرِيباً﴾: khabar; the clause عسى etc. is the speech reported, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is the khabar of عسى.

daas-irab:52-54.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time in the position of the accusative as an adverbial, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). ﴿يَدْعُوكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw because of heaviness, and the kāf is its object, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِحَمْدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "حامدين" (praising). ﴿وَتَظُنُّونَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنْ﴾: negative. ﴿لَبِثْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تظنون. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and قل is an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِعِبادِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قل, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَقُولُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command, its sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿هِيَ أَحْسَنُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ الشَّيْطانَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿يَنْزَغُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: attached to ينزغ. ﴿إِنَّ الشَّيْطانَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause is a badal (substitute) of the first إن الشيطان. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is omitted. ﴿لِلْإِنْسانِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عدوا. ﴿عَدُوًّا﴾: the khabar of kāna. ﴿مُبِيناً﴾: an adjective, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعلم. ﴿إِنْ يَشَأْ﴾: in is conditional, and an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿يَرْحَمْكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis), and its fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its object; the clause has no grammatical position because it is an apodosis not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿أَوْ إِنْ يَشَأْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ﴾: conjoined to the preceding one. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negative. ﴿أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to وكيلا. ﴿وَكِيلًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; أرسل does not normally take a second object, and وكيلا is usually parsed as a ḥāl].

daas-irab:55-56.t: ﴿وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِمَنْ﴾: من is a relative noun, genitive (majrūr), and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أعلم. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿فَضَّلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بَعْضَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿النَّبِيِّينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to فضلنا, and the clause is the answer to an oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَآتَيْنا داوُدَ زَبُوراً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ادْعُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿زَعَمْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of an implied "آلهة" (gods), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and lā is negative. ﴿يَمْلِكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَشْفَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الضُّرِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كشف. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is negative. ﴿تَحْوِيلًا﴾: conjoined to كشف.

daas-irab:57-59.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: أولاء is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is for address. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَبْتَغُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿إِلى رَبِّهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to يبتغون. ﴿الْوَسِيلَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَيُّهُمْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَقْرَبُ﴾: khabar, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of يدعون. ﴿وَيَرْجُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَحْمَتَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَخافُونَ عَذابَهُ﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿إِنَّ عَذابَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كانَ مَحْذُوراً﴾: kāna and its khabar, and its noun is omitted; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and in is negative, without governing effect. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾: mubtadaʾ, genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُهْلِكُوها﴾: khabar, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural, the nūn having been deleted because of the iḍāfa, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of قرية. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to مهلكوها. ﴿يَوْمِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ مُعَذِّبُوها﴾: conjoined to مهلكوها. ﴿عَذاباً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿شَدِيداً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿كانَ ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as the noun of kāna, the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿فِي الْكِتابِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مسطورا. ﴿مَسْطُوراً﴾: the khabar of kāna, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negative. ﴿مَنَعَنا﴾: a past verb and its first object, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ نُرْسِلَ﴾: an puts the verb in the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an; it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), the second object of منع. ﴿بِالْآياتِ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant, and الآيات is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿أَنْ﴾: lightened (mukhaffafa) from anna; its noun is omitted, being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); it and what follows it are in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of منعنا. ﴿كَذَّبَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿بِهَا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كذب. ﴿الْأَوَّلُونَ﴾: fāʿil, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَآتَيْنا ثَمُودَ النَّاقَةَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿مُبْصِرَةً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَظَلَمُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهَا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ظلموا. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negative. ﴿نُرْسِلَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِالْآياتِ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant, and الآيات is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿تَخْوِيفاً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

daas-irab:60-61.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذ is an adverb attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). ﴿قُلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قلنا. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَحاطَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿بِالنَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أحاط. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negative. ﴿جَعَلْنَا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الرُّؤْيَا﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿أَرَيْناكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿فِتْنَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالشَّجَرَةَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الرؤيا. ﴿الْمَلْعُونَةَ﴾: an adjective of الشجرة, and it is the tree of al-Zaqqūm. ﴿فِي الْقُرْآنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to الملعونة. ﴿وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and mā is negative. ﴿يَزِيدُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its first object, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿طُغْياناً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾: an adjective. ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذ is an adverb attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر". ﴿قُلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِلْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قلنا. ﴿اسْجُدُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the speech reported. ﴿لِآدَمَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اسجدوا. ﴿فَسَجَدُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿إِبْلِيسَ﴾: excepted by إلا, accusative. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَأَسْجُدُ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the speech reported. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: من is a relative noun, and the two are attached to أسجد. ﴿خَلَقْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿طِيناً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), or tamyīz (specification), or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "من طين" (from clay).

daas-irab:62-64.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَرَأَيْتَكَ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object; the meaning of أرأيتك is "أخبرني" (tell me); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿هذَا﴾: the hā is for drawing attention, and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun; it, together with its ṣila (relative clause), is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿كَرَّمْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to كرمت. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; in is a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿أَخَّرْتَنِ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil, and it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the first-person yāʾ is omitted; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخرتن. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and أحتنكنّ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is omitted; the nūn of emphasis has no grammatical position. ﴿ذُرِّيَّتَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause, like the preceding one, has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an omitted oath. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: excepted by إلا. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is omitted, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿اذْهَبْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the speech reported. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, a mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَبِعَكَ﴾: a past verb and its object, and its fāʿil is latent; it is in the position of the jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; inna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ جَزاؤُكُمْ﴾: the noun of inna and its khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of من. ﴿جَزاءً﴾: ḥāl, or tamyīz (specification), or mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مَوْفُوراً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause of the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis) is in the position of the jussive. ﴿وَاسْتَفْزِزْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَنِ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اسْتَطَعْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿بِصَوْتِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to استفزز. ﴿وَأَجْلِبْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أجلب. ﴿بِخَيْلِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أجلب. ﴿وَرَجِلِكَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَشارِكْهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its object, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْأَمْوالِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شاركهم. ﴿وَالْأَوْلادِ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿وَعِدْهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its object, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is the wāw of the ḥāl, and mā is negative. ﴿يَعِدُهُمُ الشَّيْطانُ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿غُرُوراً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) or ḥāl, and the clause is parenthetical and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:65-68.t: ﴿إِنَّ عِبادِي﴾: inna and its noun, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, its appearance being prevented by the place being occupied by the vowel suited to the yāʾ; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to the fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿سُلْطانٌ﴾: the noun of laysa, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَكَفى﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and كفى is a past verb. ﴿بِرَبِّكَ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and ربك is the fāʿil (agent), genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿وَكِيلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبُّكُمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُزْجِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يزجي. ﴿الْفُلْكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) and has no grammatical position. ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يزجي. ﴿لِتَبْتَغُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of cause, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the lām and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to يزجي. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تبتغوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيماً﴾: kāna, and its noun is omitted, and رحيما is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to رحيما, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ﴾: a past verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مسكم. ﴿ضَلَّ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil, and the clause is the apodosis of إذا. ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿إِيَّاهُ﴾: an accusative pronoun in the position of the accusative as excepted. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لمّا, the temporal one ("when"), is an adverb of time. ﴿نَجَّاكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its object, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَى الْبَرِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نجاكم. ﴿أَعْرَضْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of لما. ﴿وَكانَ الْإِنْسانُ كَفُوراً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَفَأَمِنْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَخْسِفَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخسف. ﴿جانِبَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْبَرِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ يُرْسِلَ﴾: conjoined to يخسف. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرسل. ﴿حاصِباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لا تَجِدُوا﴾: lā is negative, and an imperfect verb conjoined to what precedes it; it is accusative like it, by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجدوا. ﴿وَكِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:69-70.t: ﴿أَمْ أَمِنْتُمْ﴾: أم is a conjunction, and أمنتم is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يُعِيدَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the kāf is its object, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to يعيدكم. ﴿تارَةً﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أُخْرى﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَيُرْسِلَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرسل. ﴿قاصِفاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الرِّيحِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قاصفا. ﴿فَيُغْرِقَكُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb conjoined to what precedes it, accusative like it, and the kāf is its object, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِما﴾: mā is a relative noun; the two are attached to يغرقكم. ﴿كَفَرْتُمْ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لا تَجِدُوا﴾: lā is negative, and an imperfect verb conjoined to what precedes it, accusative like it, by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تبيعا. ﴿تَبِيعاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is a preposition and particle of oath [Translator's note: so in the source, although it then treats the oath as omitted], the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿كَرَّمْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿بَنِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿آدَمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَحَمَلْناهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿فِي الْبَرِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حملناهم. ﴿وَالْبَحْرِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to البر. ﴿وَرَزَقْناهُمْ﴾: conjoined to حملناهم, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿مِنَ الطَّيِّباتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رزقناهم. ﴿وَفَضَّلْناهُمْ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿عَلى كَثِيرٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to فضلناهم. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾: من is a preposition and مَن is a relative noun; the two are attached to كثير. ﴿خَلَقْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿تَفْضِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq.

daas-irab:71-72.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted verb, its implied form being "واذكر" (and remember). ﴿نَدْعُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw because of heaviness, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كُلَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أُناسٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِإِمامِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ندعو. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أُوتِيَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted; it is in the position of the jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis). ﴿كِتابَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِيَمِينِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوتي, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and أولاء is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is for address; the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of من. ﴿يَقْرَؤُنَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿كِتابَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is negative. ﴿يُظْلَمُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَتِيلًا﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "ظلما فتيلا". ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾: the hā is for drawing attention, and ذه is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿أَعْمى﴾: the noun of kāna, nominative by an implied ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility [Translator's note: so in the source; أعمى is usually parsed as the khabar of kāna, its noun being a latent pronoun]. ﴿فَهُوَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar. ﴿أَعْمى﴾: khabar. ﴿وَأَضَلُّ﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and it is nominative like it. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification). The clause of the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis) is in the position of the jussive because it is joined to the fāʾ, and the two clauses of the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of من.

daas-irab:73-75.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and in is lightened (mukhaffafa) from the heavy inna, its noun being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). ﴿كادُوا﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, one of the verbs of proximity, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿لَيَفْتِنُونَكَ﴾: the lām is the one that distinguishes between negation and affirmation (al-fāriqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كادوا. ﴿عَنِ الَّذِي﴾: الذي is a relative noun, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb before them. ﴿أَوْحَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوحينا. ﴿لِتَفْتَرِيَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of cause, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the lām and what follows it are attached to تفتري [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably يفتنونك is meant]. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تفتري. ﴿غَيْرَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَإِذاً﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and إذن is a particle of answer. ﴿لَاتَّخَذُوكَ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿خَلِيلًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and لولا is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a maṣdar-forming particle for the future. ﴿ثَبَّتْناكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; an and what follows it are in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar is omitted, the implied form being "ولولا تثبيتك" (were it not for Our making you firm). ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿كِدْتَ﴾: an incomplete past verb, one of the verbs of proximity, and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿تَرْكَنُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the clause is the khabar of كدت. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تركن. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of answer. ﴿لَأَذَقْناكَ﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam) [Translator's note: so in the source; in the same sentence it treats the clause as the answer to the oath, i.e. the lām of the answer], and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿ضِعْفَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَضِعْفَ الْمَماتِ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لا تَجِدُ﴾: lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجد. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نصيرا. ﴿نَصِيراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:76-78.t: ﴿وَإِنْ كادُوا لَيَسْتَفِزُّونَكَ﴾: its i'rab has passed shortly before. ﴿مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to يستفزونك. ﴿لِيُخْرِجُوكَ﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of cause, through the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām and what follows it are attached to يستفزونك. ﴿مِنْها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخرجوك. ﴿وَإِذاً﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is a particle of answer. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَلْبَثُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined, and يلبثون is the apodosis of an implied law. ﴿خِلافَكَ﴾: an adverb attached to يلبثون, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being "إلّا لبثا قليلا". ﴿سُنَّةَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, its implied form being "سنّ الله ذلك سنة". ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قَبْلَكَ﴾: قبل is an adverb of time attached to أرسلنا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ رُسُلِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا تَجِدُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negative, and تجد is an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِسُنَّتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجد, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَحْوِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَقِمِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِدُلُوكِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أقم, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no pronoun kāf in لدلوك]. ﴿الشَّمْسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلى غَسَقِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أقم. ﴿اللَّيْلِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقُرْآنَ﴾: conjoined to الصلاة. ﴿الْفَجْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ قُرْآنَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿الْفَجْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كانَ مَشْهُوداً﴾: kāna and its khabar (predicate), and its noun is omitted; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the inna clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:79-81.t: ﴿وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to تهجد. ﴿فَتَهَجَّدْ﴾: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to أقم. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تهجد. ﴿نافِلَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نافلة. ﴿عَسى﴾: a complete (tāmm) past verb. ﴿أَنْ يَبْعَثَكَ﴾: an puts the verb in the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its object; the clause is the fāʿil of عسى. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: the fāʿil of يبعث, nominative (marfūʿ), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَقاماً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because whoever "raises you" [يبعثك] "makes you stand" [يقيم]. ﴿مَحْمُوداً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of مقاما. ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle, accusative by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which was deleted for lightness; it is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَدْخِلْنِي﴾: a verb of supplication; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the speech reported. ﴿مُدْخَلَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿صِدْقٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿وَاجْعَلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اجعل. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اجعل, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سُلْطاناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَصِيراً﴾: an adjective of سلطانا. ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: its i'rab is at the beginning of the previous verse. ﴿جاءَ الْحَقُّ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the speech reported. ﴿وَزَهَقَ الْباطِلُ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿إِنَّ الْباطِلَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ زَهُوقاً﴾: kāna and its khabar (predicate), and its noun is omitted, the implied form being "كان هو"; the clause is the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:82-84.t: ﴿وَنُنَزِّلُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to ننزل. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿هُوَ شِفاءٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَرَحْمَةٌ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to شفاء. ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رحمة. ﴿وَلا يَزِيدُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negative, and يزيد is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿خَساراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿أَنْعَمْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلَى الْإِنْسانِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنعمنا. ﴿أَعْرَضَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَنَأى﴾: conjoined to أعرض. ﴿بِجانِبِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نأى. ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿مَسَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its object. ﴿الشَّرُّ﴾: fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كانَ يَؤُساً﴾: kāna and its khabar, and its noun is omitted; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يَعْمَلُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَلى شاكِلَتِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يعمل, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِمَنْ﴾: من is a relative noun, and the two are attached to أعلم. ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَهْدى﴾: khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification).

daas-irab:85-87.t: ﴿وَيَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَنِ الرُّوحِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to يسألونك. ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الرُّوحِ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar (predicate). ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negative. ﴿أُوتِيتُمْ﴾: a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الْعِلْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوتيتم. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and in is conditional. ﴿شِئْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَنَذْهَبَنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿بِالَّذِي﴾: الذي is a relative noun, and the two are attached to نذهبن. ﴿أَوْحَيْنا إِلَيْكَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أوحينا. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لا تَجِدُ﴾: lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجد, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجد. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to وكيلا. ﴿وَكِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رحمة, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ فَضْلَهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is omitted. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كبيرا. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾: the khabar of kāna; the kāna clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna, and the clause of inna and what follows it gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:88-90.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَئِنِ﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and in is conditional. ﴿اجْتَمَعَتِ الْإِنْسُ﴾: a past verb, the tāʾ is for the feminine, and الإنس is the fāʿil; it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْجِنُّ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الإنس. ﴿عَلى﴾: a preposition. ﴿أَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَأْتُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the deletion of the nūn; together with an it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive (majrūr) by على, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِمِثْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأتوا. ﴿هذَا﴾: the hā is for drawing attention, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْقُرْآنِ﴾: badal (substitute) of the demonstrative. ﴿لا يَأْتُونَ﴾: lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿بِمِثْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأتون. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is of the ḥāl, and law is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾: the noun of kāna, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِبَعْضٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ظهيرا. ﴿ظَهِيراً﴾: the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām prepares for the oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿صَرَّفْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to صرفنا. ﴿فِي هذَا﴾: ذا is a demonstrative; the two are attached to صرفنا. ﴿الْقُرْآنِ﴾: badal of the demonstrative. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of an implied mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مَثَلٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَبى أَكْثَرُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كُفُوراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿نُؤْمِنَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نؤمن. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿تَفْجُرَ لَنا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ يَنْبُوعاً﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative, and its fāʿil is latent; لنا and من الأرض are both attached to the verb, and ينبوعا is mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:91-93.t: ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تَكُونَ﴾: an imperfect incomplete (nāqiṣ) verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to the fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿جَنَّةٌ﴾: its postponed noun, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ نَخِيلٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of جنة. ﴿وَعِنَبٍ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to نخيل. ﴿فَتُفَجِّرَ﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined to تكون, accusative (manṣūb) like it, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْأَنْهارَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿خِلالَها﴾: an adverb of place, and the hā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَفْجِيراً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تُسْقِطَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿السَّماءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition, and mā is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿زَعَمْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; mā and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تسقط. ﴿كِسَفاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿أَوْ تَأْتِيَ﴾: أو is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ; the two are attached to تأتي. ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿قَبِيلًا﴾: ḥāl. ﴿أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ﴾: أو is a conjunction, and the i'rab of this clause is like the i'rab of أو تكون لك جنة. ﴿مِنْ زُخْرُفٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of بيت. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تَرْقى﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined to what preceded, accusative by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي السَّماءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ترقى. ﴿وَلَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lan puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿نُؤْمِنَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِرُقِيِّكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نؤمن, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿تُنَزِّلَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after حتى, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تنزل. ﴿كِتاباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَقْرَؤُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is its object; the clause is an adjective of كتابا. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سُبْحانَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle. ﴿كُنْتُ﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بَشَراً﴾: the khabar of كنت. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: an adjective.

daas-irab:94-96.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negative. ﴿مَنَعَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوا﴾: an puts the verb in the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an through the deletion of the nūn; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), the second mafʿūl bihi of منع. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached (mutaʿalliq) to منع. ﴿جاءَهُمُ الْهُدى﴾: a past verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾: maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; an and what follows it are in the position of the nominative as the postponed fāʿil of منع, the implied form being "إلا قولهم" (except their saying). ﴿أَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and a past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَشَراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَلائِكَةٌ﴾: the noun of kāna. ﴿يَمْشُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is an adjective of الملائكة. ﴿مُطْمَئِنِّينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَنَزَّلْنا﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of law, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ and ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: the two prepositions and their genitive nouns are attached to نزلنا. ﴿مَلَكاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: an adjective. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on an implied fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the Divine Name is the fāʿil. ﴿شَهِيداً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿بَيْنِي﴾: an adverb of place, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and ﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾: conjoined to بيني; the clause is the speech reported. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete past verb, and its noun is omitted. ﴿بِعِبادِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خبيرا. ﴿خَبِيراً﴾: the khabar of kāna, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿بَصِيراً﴾: a second khabar.

daas-irab:97-98.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَهْدِ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), its sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter, and the Divine Name is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and mubtadaʾ and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis), and the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of من. ﴿وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُضْلِلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿فَلَنْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and lan puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿تَجِدَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ, and the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of من. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to تجد. ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أولياء, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to نحشرهم. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى وُجُوهِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عُمْياً﴾: mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; عميا is usually parsed as a ḥāl]. ﴿وَبُكْماً وَصُمًّا﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿مَأْواهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿كُلَّما﴾: an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿خَبَتْ﴾: a past verb, the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿زِدْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿سَعِيراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ, the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿جَزاؤُهُمْ﴾: khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾: anna and its noun; it and what follows it are in the position of the genitive, and the two are attached to جزاؤهم. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كفروا, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَإِذا﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: kāna and its noun, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِظاماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; it is the khabar of كنا]. ﴿وَرُفاتاً﴾: conjoined to عظاما. ﴿أَإِنَّا﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَمَبْعُوثُونَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the khabar of inna, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw. ﴿خَلْقاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿جَدِيداً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the speech after قالوا is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:99-100.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, the wāw is resumptive, and lam is a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past). ﴿يَرَوْا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي﴾: anna, and the Divine Name is its noun, and the relative noun is an adjective (ṣifa); anna and what follows it take the place of the two objects of يروا. ﴿خَلَقَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات. ﴿قادِرٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of anna. ﴿عَلى أَنْ يَخْلُقَ﴾: an puts the verb in the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative, and its fāʿil is latent; an and what follows it are in the position of the genitive, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to قادر. ﴿مِثْلَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَجَعَلَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جعل. ﴿أَجَلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا رَيْبَ﴾: lā is the lā of generic negation, and ريب is its noun. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar, and the clause is an adjective of أجلا. ﴿فَأَبَى الظَّالِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُوراً﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and أبى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility, and الظالمون is the fāʿil, and إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and كفورا is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of the fāʿil omitted together with its verb, because law enters upon the verb, and the clause [Translator's note: so in the source]; the omitted clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿تَمْلِكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿خَزائِنَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَحْمَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of answer. ﴿لَأَمْسَكْتُمْ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of law, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of law. ﴿خَشْيَةَ﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿الْإِنْفاقِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكانَ الْإِنْسانُ قَتُوراً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:101-102.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مُوسى﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿تِسْعَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آياتٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بَيِّناتٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَسْئَلْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿بَنِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَهُمْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is its object; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَقالَ لَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to it. ﴿فِرْعَوْنُ﴾: fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَأَظُنُّكَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its first object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿يا مُوسى﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and موسى is a vocative, a single proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility, in the position of the accusative as a vocative; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿مَسْحُوراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of أظن. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation. ﴿عَلِمْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ما أَنْزَلَ﴾: mā is negative, and a past verb. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾: the hā is for drawing attention, and أولاء is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿رَبُّ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات, and the clause takes the place of the two objects of علمت. ﴿بَصائِرَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), and the oath clause is in the position of the accusative as the speech reported. ﴿وَإِنِّي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and inna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَأَظُنُّكَ﴾: the shifted lām, and أظنك is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its first object; the clause is the khabar. ﴿يا فِرْعَوْنُ﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and فرعون is a vocative, indeclinable on the ḍamma. ﴿مَثْبُوراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:103-106.t: ﴿فَأَرادَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَسْتَفِزَّهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أن يستفزهم and what follows it are in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to يستفزهم. ﴿فَأَغْرَقْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: من is a relative noun conjoined to the hāʾ in أغرقناه. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَقُلْنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قلنا. ﴿لِبَنِي﴾: the lām is a preposition, and بني is genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; the two are attached to قلنا. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اسْكُنُوا الْأَرْضَ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَ وَعْدُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جِئْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the speech reported [Translator's note: so in the source; it is the apodosis of إذا within the reported speech]. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جئنا. ﴿لَفِيفاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿وَبِالْحَقِّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أنزلناه. ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَ﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and its i'rab is like it; the fāʿil of نزل is latent. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is negative. ﴿أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مُبَشِّراً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿وَنَذِيراً﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to مبشرا. ﴿وَقُرْآناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَرَقْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is explicative (mufassira). ﴿لِتَقْرَأَهُ﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after it, and its fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the lām and what follows it are a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فرقناه. ﴿عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تقرأه. ﴿عَلى مُكْثٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَنَزَّلْناهُ تَنْزِيلًا﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil, its object and a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:107-109.t: ﴿قُلْ آمِنُوا﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive; and an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to آمنوا. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾: prohibitive. ﴿تُؤْمِنُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna. ﴿أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and it is its first object, and العلم is its second object. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوتوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿يُتْلى﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility, and the nāʾib fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتلى. ﴿يَخِرُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of إذا;
