The preposition «عليك» is attached to «حسيبا», and «حسيبا» is a tamyīz (specification). «كفى» was not made feminine because its fāʿil is figuratively feminine.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «من اهتدى»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «فإنما يهتدي لنفسه» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «وِزْرَ» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وما كنا» is resumptive, and the clause «ولا تزر» is conjoined to the clause «مَنْ اهتدى». The genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (حتى أن نبعث) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «معذِّبين». The clause «نبعث» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {وَمَا كُنَّا}. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن نهلك» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «أمرنا» is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: His words «وكم أهلكنا»: the wāw is resumptive; «كم» is the declarative (khabariyya) kam, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «من القرون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كم»; the preposition «من بعد» is attached to «أهلكنا». The clause «وكفى بربك» is resumptive, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the fāʿil (agent) of «كفى». «خبيرا بصيرا» are two tamyīzes (specifications).

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «مَنْ»: conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject). The two prepositional phrases «له فيها» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عجَّلْنا», and the preposition «لمن» is a badal (substitute) of «له», part for whole. The clause «يصلاها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «له». His words «مذموما مدحورا»: two ḥāls of the hāʾ in «يصلاها».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: «سعيَها»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «وهو مؤمن» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «سعى». The clause «فأولئك كان سعيهم مشكورا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause «كان سعيهم مشكورا» is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «كُلا»: a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «نمد»; «هؤلاء» is a badal (substitute) of «كلا», and the second «هؤلاء» is conjoined to the first. The preposition «من عطاء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نمدّ». The clause «وما كان عطاء» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «فضَّلنا» is the object of the looking, which contains the sense of knowing and is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative. «كيف» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «وللآخرة أكبر» is resumptive; the lām is for emphasis, and «درجات» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «مع»: an adverb of place for accompaniment, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعل». His words «فتقعد»: the fāʾ is causal; an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن; and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: لا يكن منك جَعْلٌ فقعودٌ (let there not be from you a setting up and then a sitting). His words «مذموما مخذولا»: two ḥāls (circumstantials) of the pronoun "you" (أنت).

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «ألا تعبدوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. «إياه» is a detached accusative pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). His words «وبالوالدين إحسانا»: the wāw is a conjunction; the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «أحسنوا»; «إحسانا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and the implied clause «أحسنوا» is conjoined to the clause «تعبدوا». His words «إمَّا»: composed of the conditional «إنْ» and the redundant «ما»; the imperfect verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the jussive, and the nūn is for emphasis. «الكِبَر» is the mafʿūl bihi; «أحدهما» is a postponed fāʿil (agent). «أو كلاهما»: «أو» is a conjunction; «كلاهما» is a conjoined noun, nominative with the alif because it is assimilated to the dual. His words «أف»: a verbal noun with the sense of an imperfect, meaning أتضجَّر (I am vexed), and the fāʿil is the pronoun "I" (أنا).

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The preposition «من الرحمة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اخفض». «كما»: the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya; [ربَّياني is] a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the alif of the dual; the alif is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «صغيرا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi, i.e.: have mercy on them with a mercy like their raising of me. The clause «ربَّياني» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: «بما»: the bāʾ is a preposition; «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم». The clause «ربكم أعلم» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, and the clause «إن تكونوا» is resumptive within the scope of the parenthesis. The preposition «للأوابين» is attached to «غفورا».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: His words «وآتِ»: the wāw is a conjunction; an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; its two objects are ذا and حقه. The clause is conjoined to the clause «قل».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «إن المبذرين كانوا» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, and the clause «وكان الشيطان كفورا» is conjoined to the clause «إن المبذرين كانوا». The preposition «لربه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «وإما»: the wāw is a conjunction, «إنْ» is conditional and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and the nūn is for emphasis. The fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun "you" (أنت). «ابتغاء» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the preposition «من ربك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة»; the clause «ترجوها» is a second naʿt of «رحمة».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «مغلولة»: a second object; the preposition «إلى عنقك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مغلولة»; «كل» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). His words «فتقعد»: the fāʾ is causal, and the verb is accusative by an implied أن; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: لا يكن بَسْط فقعود (let there not be an extending and then a sitting). «ملوما محسورا» are two ḥāls (circumstantials) of the pronoun in «تقعد».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «إن ربك يبسط» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, and the clause «إنه كان» is resumptive within the scope of the parenthesis. The preposition «بعباده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خبيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «خشية»: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). «وإياكم» is a detached pronoun conjoined to the hāʾ in «يرزقهم». The clause «نحن نرزقهم» is resumptive, and so is the clause «إنَّ قتلهم كان».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «إنه كان» is resumptive, and the clause «وساء سبيلا» is conjoined to the clause «إنه كان». «سبيلا» is a tamyīz (specification), and the one specified for blame is omitted, its implied form being هو, i.e.: الزنى (fornication).

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «التي»: a naʿt (adjective) of النفس; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «تقتلوا». The clause «ومن قتل» is resumptive; «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject); «مظلوما» is a ḥāl of the pronoun in «قتل». The clause «فلا يسرف» is conjoined to the clause «جعلنا»; conjoining a command-type (inshāʾ) clause to a declarative (khabar) one is permitted. The clause «إنه كان» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The preposition «بالتي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «تقربوا»; «أشدَّه» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وأوفوا» is conjoined to the clause «لا تقربوا», and the clause «إن العهد كان مسؤولا» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The conditional clause with its implied apodosis is resumptive; the clause «كِلْتم» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «ذلك خير» is parenthetical; «تأويلا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: His words «ولا تقف»: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter. «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of ليس; the preposition «به» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «علم»; «علم» is the noun of ليس. The clause «كل أولئك كان» is the khabar of «إن»; «أولئك» is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause «إن السمع ... » is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «مرحا»: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial); «طولا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: (ذلك مما أوحى إليك ربك من الحكمة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The demonstrative points to the obligations mentioned before. The preposition «من الحكمة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied referent pronoun, i.e.: أوحاه كائنا من الحكمة (He revealed it, being of wisdom). «مع» is an adverb of place attached to the second object of «جعل». The fāʾ in «فتُلقى» is causal; an imperfect passive verb, accusative by an implied أَنْ; and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: لا يكن جَعْل فإلقاء (let there not be a setting up and then a casting).

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The clause «أفأصفاكم» is resumptive; the preposition «من الملائكة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «ولقد صرَّفنا» is resumptive. The clause «وما يزيدهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «صَرَّفنا». The fāʿil (agent) of «يزيدهم» is a pronoun whose implied form is هو, i.e.: the varying [of the discourse]. «نفورا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The conditional clause is what is said (maqūl al-qawl). «معه» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The kāf in «كما» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e.: if there were gods with Him, a being like their saying. «سبيلا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The preposition «عمَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تعالى»; it is composed of the preposition «عن» and the relative «ما». The clause «وتعالى» is conjoined to the governor of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: تنزه وتعالى (He is far removed and exalted).

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: «مَنْ»: a relative noun conjoined to السماوات; the preposition «فيهن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). His words «وإن من شيء إلا يسبح»: the wāw is a conjunction; «شيء» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); and the clause «يسبح» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «وإن من شيء إلا يسبح» is conjoined to the resumptive «تسبح له السماوات». The preposition «بحمده» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يسبح», and «إلا» is for restriction. The clause «ولكن لا تفقهون» is conjoined to the clause «إنْ من شيء ... ».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «قرأت» is muḍāf ilayhi. «بينك» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: «أكنَّة»: the object of «جعل», and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يفقهوه» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: كراهة (out of dislike that). «وفي آذانهم وقرا»: the prepositional phrase is conjoined to «على قلوبهم», and «وقرًا» is conjoined to «أكنَّة». The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ}. «وحده»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ربك» in the sense of منفردا (alone); it is thus definite in form with the force of an indefinite. «نفورا» is a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «ولَّوا», and the clause «ولَّوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The preposition «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم»; whatever belongs to the domain of knowledge and ignorance among elatives (afʿal al-tafḍīl) is made transitive with the bāʾ, as in: أنت أعلم به (you know it better). The preposition «به» is attached to the imperfect verb, i.e.: they listen with their outward hearing. The clause «يستمعون» is muḍāf ilayhi; «إذ يستمعون» is an adverb attached to «أعلم». His words «وإذ هم نجوى»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذ» is an adverb conjoined to the «إذ» before it and attached to what that is attached to; «نجوى» is a maṣdar (verbal noun), as a case of applying the maṣdar to the person by way of intensification; and the clause «هم نجوى» is muḍāf ilayhi. «إذ يقول»: the adverb is a badal (substitute) of «إذ هم». «إن تتبعون»: «إن» is negating, «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and the clause is what is said (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «كيف»: an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause «ضربوا» is the object of the looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative and contains the sense of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «إذا»: a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the implied apodosis, i.e.: أنُبعث إذا (shall we be raised when…). «مبعوثون» does not govern «إذا», because what comes after «إنَّ» does not govern what precedes it, and likewise what comes after the interrogative does not govern what precedes it, and both are combined here. «خلقا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «مبعوثون», and the clause «أإنا لمبعوثون» is explicative of the implied apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The preposition «ممَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of خلقا. «من» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يعيدنا» is the khabar (predicate). «أول» is an adverb of time attached to «فطركم». The clause «فسينغضون» is resumptive. «متى» is an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to the khabar; «هو» is the mubtadaʾ; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يكون» is the fāʿil (agent) of the complete «عسى», i.e.: عسى كونه قريبا (perhaps its being is near).

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: «يوم»: the object of an implied «اذكر» (remember), and the clause «اذكر» is resumptive. The clause «يدعوكم» is muḍāf ilayhi. The preposition «بحمده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تستجيبون», by making it contain the sense of تُسَبِّحون (you glorify). The clause «فتستجيبون» is conjoined to the clause «يدعوكم». The clause «إن لبثتم» stands in place of the two objects of «ظنَّ», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by «إنْ»; «إن» is negating, «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «قليلا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: لبثا قليلا (a short stay).

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The clause «وقل» is resumptive, and what is said (maqūl al-qawl) is implied, i.e.: say to them what you wish. «يقولوا» is jussive (majzūm), occurring as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: إن تقل لهم يقولوا (if you tell them, they will say), for they comply. The clause «إن الشيطان كان» is resumptive, and the preposition «للإنسان» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدوا».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The preposition «بكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «وما أرسلناك» is parenthetical. The preposition «عليهم» is attached to أرسلناك, and «وكيلا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf in «أرسلناك».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause), and the clause «ولقد فَضَّلْنا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The preposition «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative noun, and the two objects of the claiming are omitted, i.e.: زعمتموهم آلهة (you claimed them to be gods). The clause «فلا يملكون» is conjoined to the clause «ادعوا»; the preposition «عنكم» is attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) (كشف).

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «الذين»: a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, and the referent pronoun is omitted, i.e.: يدعونهم. The clause «يبتغون» is the khabar (predicate). His words «أيهم أقرب»: a relative noun, a badal of the wāw in «يبتغون»; it is indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is in construct and the beginning of its ṣila (relative clause) has been omitted. «أقرب» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هو أقرب. That is: those whom they call upon — the one of them who is nearest to Him the Exalted seeks the means [of approach], so how about one below him? The clause «إن عذاب ربك كان محذورا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: His words «وإن من قرية»: the wāw is resumptive; «إن» is negating; «قرية» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); and the clause «نحن مهلكوها» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. «قبل» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مهلكوها». «عذابا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its governor being the active participle. The clause «كان ذلك» is resumptive. The preposition «في الكتاب» is attached to «مَسْطورا».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «وما منعنا» is conjoined to the clause «إن من قرية». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن نرسل» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «منع»; «منع» is transitive by itself and with a preposition, as in: منعته النوم and من النوم (I kept him from sleep). The maṣdar «أن كذب» is the fāʿil (agent) of منع. The clause «وآتينا» is parenthetical. «مبصرة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الناقة». The clause «فظلموا» is conjoined to the clause «آتينا», and the clause «وما نرسل» is conjoined to the clause «منعنا». «تخويفا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: «وإذ»: the wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر» (remember). The implied clause «اذكر» is resumptive, and the clause «قلنا» is muḍāf ilayhi. «التي» is a naʿt (adjective) of الرؤيا. The preposition «للناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of فتنة; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «الشجرة» is conjoined to «الرؤيا»; the preposition «في القرآن» is attached to «الملعونة»; «فتنة» is the second object of «جعل»; «طغيانا» is a second object. The clause «وما جعلنا» is conjoined to the implied resumptive one: اذكر; the clause «ونخوفهم» is conjoined to the implied resumptive one; and the clause «فما يزيدهم» is conjoined to the clause «نخوفهم».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «وإذ»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذ» is an adverbial noun conjoined [to] the earlier «إذ». «طينا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the referent pronoun of the relative noun, i.e.: خلقته طينا; the ḥāl is permitted to be a non-derived (jāmid) noun because it indicates origin, as though He said: متأصِّلا من طين (originating from clay).

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: His words «أرأيتك»: the hamza is interrogative, the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is for address; the meaning of the verb is أخبرني (tell me). The demonstrative is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «الذي» is a badal (substitute), and the second object is an implied interrogative clause, i.e.: أتكرّمه وأنا خير منه؟ (do You honour him while I am better than him?). His words «لئن أخرتن»: the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa), «إن» is conditional; a past verb, the tāʾ is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi — it was dropped for lightening and the kasra sufficed in its place. «قليلا» is an accusative excepted (mustathnā). The clause «لأحتنكن» is the apodosis of the oath, and the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «اذهب». «مَنْ» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «تبعك» is the khabar (predicate). «جزاء» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governor is the maṣdar (verbal noun) before it.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «مَنْ», i.e.: كائنين منهم (being of them). The preposition «بصوتك» is attached to «استفزز». The preposition «بخيلك» is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «أجلب», i.e.: مصاحبا بخيلك (accompanied by your horsemen). The clause «وما يعدهم» is resumptive; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); and «غرورا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: وعدًا غرورا (a deceptive promise).

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the preposition «عليهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سلطان». The clause «وكفى بربك» is resumptive, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the fāʿil (agent) of «كفى». «وكيلا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: «الذي»: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ربُّكم». The two prepositional phrases «لكم» and «في البحر» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يزجي», and so is the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «لتبتغوا»; two particles of the same wording may be attached to a single governor because the second is a badal (substitute) of the first. The clause «إنه كان» is resumptive, and the preposition «بكم» is attached to «رحيما».

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {رَبُّكُمُ الَّذِي يُزْجِي}. The clause «مسَّكم» is muḍāf ilayhi. «إياه» is a detached accusative pronoun, excepted (mustathnā), and the hāʾ is for the third person. The clause «فلمَّا نجاكم» is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause, and the clause «وكان الإنسان كفورا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «أفأمنتم» is resumptive. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يخسف» is [accusative] by removal of the preposition «مِنْ». The preposition «بكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «جانب», and «جانب» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition «لكم» is attached to the implied second object, and «وكيلا» is the first object.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The clause «أم أمنتم» is resumptive, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يعيدكم» is [accusative] by removal of the preposition (من). «تارة» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The preposition «من الريح» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «قاصفا». «ما» in His words «بما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is genitive, attached to «يغرقكم». The preposition «لكم» is attached to the second object of «وجد», «تبيعا» is the first object, the preposition «علينا» is attached to «تبيعا», and the preposition «به» is attached to «وجد».

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The clause «ولقد كرَّمنا» is resumptive; the preposition «ممن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كثير».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: «يوم»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر» (remember), and the clause «اذكر» is resumptive; the conditional clause is conjoined to the clause اذكر. The preposition «بإمامهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ندعو». «من» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «فأولئك يقرؤون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «فتيلا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: they will not be wronged by a wrong the size of a date-stone thread (fatīl).

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The preposition «في هذه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعمى»; «سبيلا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The clause «وإن كادوا» is resumptive. «إن» is lightened from the heavy [إنّ] and is inoperative; [كادوا is] an abrogating past verb with its noun, and the lām after it is the differentiating lām (al-fāriqa) that distinguishes the lightened [إن] from the negating one. The preposition «عن الذي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يفتنون» in the sense of يَصْرفون (to turn away), and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «لتفتري» is attached to «يَفتنون». His words «وإذًا لاتخذوك»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذًا» is an inoperative particle of answer; and the lām occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: لو فعلت ذلك لاتخذوك (had you done that, they would have taken you). The clause «اتخذوك» is the apodosis of an implied condition, and the conditional clause «ولو فعلت لاتخذوك» is conjoined to the resumptive «وإن كادوا».

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: His words «ولولا أن ثبتناك»: the wāw is a conjunction; «لولا» is a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence; «أن» is maṣdariyya, followed by a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: موجود, i.e.: ولولا تثبيتنا لك موجود (were it not that Our making you firm exists). «شيئا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «لقد كِدْتَ» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: His words «إذًا لأذقناك»: a particle of answer, and the lām occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: لو فَعَلْتَ ذلك لأذقناك (had you done that, We would have made you taste). The preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object; the preposition «علينا» is attached to «نصيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The clause «وإن كادوا» is conjoined to the clause «إن كادوا» in verse (73). «إن» is lightened and inoperative, and the lām after it is the differentiating lām (al-fāriqa). The clause «يستفزّونك» is the khabar (predicate) of كاد. His words «وإذًا»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذًا» is an inoperative particle of answer because it does not stand at the head [of its clause]. His words «خلافك»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يلبث». «قليلا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: لبثًا قليلا (a short stay). The implied clause «ولو فعلوا ذلك» is conjoined to the clause «إن كادوا», and the clause «لا يلبثون» is the apodosis of the implied condition, i.e.: لو أخرجوك لا يلبثون (had they expelled you, they would not remain).

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: «سنةَ»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied governor, i.e.: سَنَّ الله ذلك (Allah laid that down as a way); the clause «سَنَّ» is resumptive. The relative noun is muḍāf ilayhi; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرسلنا»; and the prepositional phrase is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied object of «أرسلنا», i.e.: أرسلناه كائنا مِنْ رسلنا (We sent him, being of Our messengers). The preposition «لسنتنا» is attached to the second object of «تجد», and «تحويلا» is the first object.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: (لدلوك الشمس إلى غسق الليل) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقم». His words «وقرآن»: a noun conjoined to «الصلاة».

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: His words «ومن الليل»: the wāw is a conjunction; the preposition «من الليل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «اسهر» (stay awake), and the implied clause is conjoined to the clause {أَقِمِ}. His words «فتهجَّد»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the implied «اسهر». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يبعثك» is the fāʿil (agent) of عسى. «مقاما»: a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: He raises you possessing a station. The clause «عسى أن يبعثك» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «ربِّ»: one addressed in the vocative, in construct, accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the dropped first-person yāʾ. «مُدخَل» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object; and «من لدنك» — [لدن is] an adverbial noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, attached to that same implied second object.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The clause «وننزل» is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «للمؤمنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة»; «خسارا» is the second object of «يزيد», and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). The clause «ولا يزيد» is conjoined to the clause «ننزل».

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The clause «أنعمنا» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: Beginning with the indefinite «كل» is permitted because it indicates generality, and its tanwīn is in compensation for a single word, i.e.: كل أحد (everyone). The clause «فربكم أعلم» is conjoined to the clause «كل يعمل»; the preposition «بمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعلم; «سبيلا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The clause «ويسألونك» is resumptive; the clause «وما أوتيتم» is conjoined to what is said (maqūl al-qawl); the preposition «من العلم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «قليلا» is the second object of «أوتيتم».

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The clause «ولئن شئنا» is resumptive; the clause «لنذهبنَّ» is the apodosis of the oath, and the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of the oath. The clause «لا تجد» is conjoined to the clause «نذهبن», and it is not emphasised with the nūn because it is negated. His words «لا تجد»: transitive to two objects, the first «وكيلا», and the second what «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq). The preposition «به» is attached to the verb, and the preposition «علينا» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «وكيلا». The implied form is: ثم لا تجد به وكيلا علينا لك.

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: «إلا»: a particle of exception; «رحمة» is the excepted (mustathnā); the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة»; and the preposition «عليك» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «كبيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The lām in «لئن» prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa). The clause «لا يأتون» is the apodosis of the oath, and the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of the oath; it is not emphasised with the nūn because it is negated. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «على أن يأتوا» is genitive by «على», attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اجتمعت». The clause «ولو كان بعضهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يأتون»; the wāw is circumstantial, conjoined to an implied ḥāl for the sake of comprehensiveness, i.e.: they will not produce its like in any state, even in this state.

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: The clause «ولقد صرَّفنا» is resumptive; the preposition «في هذا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صرَّفْنا»; the preposition «من كل» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of the omitted object, i.e.: مثلا كائنا من كل مثل (an example, being of every example). The clause «فأبى» is conjoined to the clause «صرَّفنا»; «كفورا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr).

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The preposition «من الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ينبوعا».

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: The preposition «من نخيل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «جنة».

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: His words «كما زعمت»: the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e.: you cause [the sky] to fall, a causing to fall like your claim. «كسفًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «السماء»; «قبيلا» is a ḥāl of the Name of Majesty and the angels.

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The preposition «من زخرف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بيت»; the clause «ولن نؤمن» is conjoined to the clause «ترقى»; the clause «نقرؤه» is a naʿt of «كتابا»; and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) after «حتى» is attached to «نؤمن». His words «سبحان»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied governor, and [ربي is] muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «سبحان ربي» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause «هل كنت إلا بشرا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يؤمنوا» is the second object of «منع»; «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤمنوا»; the maṣdar «أن قالوا» is the fāʿil (agent) of «منع»; and the clause «أبعث الله» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the clause «يمشون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ملائكة»; the preposition «من السماء» is attached to the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: The bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the fāʿil (agent) of «كفى»; «شهيدا» is a tamyīz (specification); «بيني» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهيدا». The clause «إنه كان» is resumptive, and «خبيرا بصيرا» are two khabars (predicates) of كان.

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The clause «ومن يهد» is resumptive; «مَن» is a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «المهتد» is a nominative khabar (predicate), with a ḍamma implied on the dropped yāʾ. The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object; the preposition «من دونه» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of أولياء; the preposition «على وجوههم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «نحشرهم»; and the clause «مأواهم جهنم» is a ḥāl of the object of «نحشرهم». His words «كلما»: كل is an adverb of time attached to «زدناهم», «ما» is a temporal maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi; the implied form is: زدناهم سعيرا كل وقت خبوِّها (We increase them in blaze every time it abates). The clause «زدناهم» is a ḥāl of «جهنم».

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: «ذلك جزاؤهم»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «بأنهم كفروا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (جزاء). «إذا» is a conditional adverb attached to the content of the apodosis, its implied form being نبعث (we are raised); «خَلْقا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «مبعوثون»; and the clause «أإنا لمبعوثون» is explicative of the implied apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن الله» stands in place of the two objects of رأى, and the interpreted maṣdar «أن يخلق» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قادر». The clause «وجعل» is conjoined to the clause «أولم يروا», because it has the force of: قد رأوا (they have indeed seen). The clause «لا ريب فيه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أجلا».

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: «أنتم»: the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb explained by what follows; it is not a mubtadaʾ (subject), because «لو» is restricted to verbal clauses. The clause «تملكون» is explicative of the implied [verb], and the clause «أمسكتم» is the apodosis of لو. «إذًا» is a particle of answer. The clause «وكان الإنسان قتورا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: «بينات»: a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات». The clause «فاسأل بني إسرائيل» is parenthetical. «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آتينا», and the fāʿil (agent) of «جاءهم» is «موسى». The clause «فقال له فرعون» is conjoined to the clause «آتينا»; the clause «يا موسى» is parenthetical; and the lām in «لأظنك» is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: «ما» is negating; «هؤلاء» is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «ربُّ» is a postponed fāʿil (agent); «بصائر» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «هؤلاء»; and the vocative clause «يا فرعون» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: (فأراد أن يستفزهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the object of «أراد». «مَن» is a relative noun conjoined to the hāʾ; «معه» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause); «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ and of «مَن».

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «اسكنوا». «لفيفا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf in «بكم».

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: His words «وبالحق»: the wāw is resumptive, and the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «أنزلناه», and so is what follows it. «مبشِّرًا» is a ḥāl of the kāf.

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: His words «وقرآنا»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «قرآنا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows. The clause «فرقنا» is conjoined to the clause {أَنْزَلْنَاهُ}, and the clause «فرقناه» is explicative. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «لتقرأه» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فرقناه», and the second prepositional phrase «على مكث» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تقرأ».

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The preposition «من قبله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أوتوا»; the conditional clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «سُجَّدا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يخرون».

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: «سبحان»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «إن» is lightened and inoperative, and the lām after it is the differentiating lām (al-fāriqa). The clause «إن كان» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: The clause «يبكون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يخرُّون»; «خشوعا» is the second object of «يزيدهم».

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: His words «أيًّا ما»: a conditional noun, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida). «تَدْعوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: The preposition «في الملك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شريك»; the preposition «من الذل» is attached to «ولي»; and the clause «ولم يكن» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause).

mekki-muskil:1-1.t: The meaning of سُبْحَانَ الله is declaring Allah free of evil; this is related from the Prophet ﷺ. It is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), as though it were put in the place of سبحت الله تسبيحا ("I glorified Allah with a glorification"). It is definite when used alone, and at its end are two augments, the alif and the nūn, so it is a diptote because of definiteness and the two augments. It is related from Sībawayh that some of the Arabs make it indefinite and say سبحانًا with nunation. Abū ʿUbayd said it is accusative as a vocative, as though He said "O glory of Allah, O glory of Him who carried by night (يَا سُبْحَانَ الله يَا سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي أسرى)".

mekki-muskil:100-100.t: His saying {قل لَو أَنْتُم}: "لولا" [Translator's note: so in the text; the sense requires لو — "لو is followed only by a verb"] is followed only by a verb, because it carries the meaning of condition; if [the verb] is not overt, it is implied. So it is implied here, and أنتم is nominative as the agent of the implied verb.

mekki-muskil:101-101.t:
His saying {تسع آيَات بَيِّنَات}: it is permissible for بينات to be in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of آيات, or in the position of accusative as a naʿt of تسع.
His saying {وبالحق أَنزَلْنَاهُ وبالحق نزل}: the first بالحق is a fronted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied pronoun in أنزلناه, and the second بالحق is a fronted ḥāl from the implied pronoun in نزل. It is also permissible for the bāʾ in the second to be attached to نزل by way of transitivity.

mekki-muskil:104-104.t: His saying {لفيفا}: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

mekki-muskil:106-106.t: His saying {وقرآنا فرقناه}: قرآن is accusative by an implied verb which فرقناه explains; its implied form is "and We divided a Quran — We divided it". It is also permissible for it to be conjoined to مبشرا ونذيرا, in the sense of "and the bearer of a Quran", then the muḍāf was omitted; in which case فرقناه is a naʿt (adjective) of the Quran.

mekki-muskil:107-107.t: His saying {للأذقان سجدا}: [سجدا is] accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

mekki-muskil:11-11.t: His saying {ويدع الْإِنْسَان بِالشَّرِّ دعاءه بِالْخَيرِ}: دعاءه is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun). In the speech there is an omission; its implied form is "and man prays for evil [with a prayer like] his prayer for good"; then the qualified noun, which is دعاء, was omitted, then the annexed attribute was omitted, and the muḍāf ilayhi took its place.

mekki-muskil:110-110.t: His saying {أيا مَا تدعوا}: أيّ is accusative by تدعوا, and مَا is redundant (zāʾida) for emphasis.

mekki-muskil:14-14.t: His saying {عَلَيْك حسيبا}: accusative as a specification (bayān); it has also been said, as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

mekki-muskil:21-21.t:
His saying {انْظُر كَيفَ فضلنَا}: كيف is in the position of accusative by فضلنا, and انظر does not govern it, because the interrogative is not governed by what precedes it [Translator's note: the text reads "is governed by what precedes it", evidently missing the negation].
His saying {أكبر دَرَجَات}: أكبر is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject), which is الآخرة, and درجات is accusative as a specification (bayān); likewise تفضيلا.

mekki-muskil:28-28.t: His saying {ابْتِغَاء رَحْمَة} and {خشيَة إملاق}: both are mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

mekki-muskil:3-3.t:
His saying {ذُرِّيَّة من حملنَا}: ذرية is the second object of تتخذوا, according to the reading of whoever reads with tāʾ, and وكيلا is the first object; it is singular with a plural meaning. اتخذ takes two objects, as in His saying, the Exalted, وَاتخذ الله إِبْرَاهِيم خَلِيلًا. It is also permissible to make ذرية accusative as a vocative.
As for whoever reads يتخذوا with yāʾ, ذرية is the second object and nothing else; the vocative is far-fetched, because the yāʾ is for the absent [third person] while the vocative is for address, so they do not combine except remotely.
It has also been said that ذرية in both readings is a badal (substitute) from وكيل; and it has also been said it is accusative on the implication of أعني ("I mean"). In speech the nominative is permissible according to the reading of whoever reads with yāʾ, as a badal from the implied pronoun in يتخذوا; this is not good in the reading with tāʾ, because the absent is not substituted for the one addressed. The genitive is permissible as a badal from بني إسرائيل.
أن in His saying ألا يتخذوا, in the reading of whoever reads with yāʾ, is in the position of accusative on the dropping of the preposition, i.e. "so that they do not take (لِئَلَّا يتخذوا)". As for whoever reads with tāʾ, أن admits three aspects. The first: it has no grammatical position and is explicative (tafsīr), meaning أي, so لا is prohibitive, and the meaning of the speech has passed from report to prohibition. The second: أن is redundant, not explicative, and the speech is a report after a report on the implication of a verb of saying; its implied form is "and We said to them: do not take". The third: أن is in the position of accusative and لا is redundant, with the preposition omitted together with أن; its implied form is "and We made it a guidance for the Children of Israel because of your taking a guardian besides Me", i.e. out of aversion to your taking.

mekki-muskil:32-32.t: His saying {وَلَا تقربُوا الزِّنَى}: whoever shortens الزنى makes it the maṣdar (verbal noun) of زنى يزني زنى, and whoever lengthens it (الزناء) makes it the maṣdar of زانى يزاني زناء ومزاناة.

mekki-muskil:33-33.t:
His saying {وَمن قتل مَظْلُوما}: مظلوما is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
His saying {إِنَّه كَانَ منصورا}: the hāʾ refers to the next of kin (al-walī); it has also been said, to the one killed; it has also been said, to the blood; and it has also been said, to the killing. Abū ʿUbayd said it is for the killer, its meaning being that the killer, when retaliation is taken from him in this world and he is killed, is helped [thereby]; this is far-fetched in interpretation.

mekki-muskil:37-37.t: His saying {مرحا}: accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun). Yaʿqūb read مَرِحًا with kasra on the rāʾ, so its accusative is as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

mekki-muskil:41-41.t: His saying {نفورا}: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

mekki-muskil:5-5.t:
His saying {خلال الديار}: accusative as an adverb (ẓarf).
His saying {كلا نمد هَؤُلَاءِ}: كلا is made accusative by نمد, and هؤلاء is a badal (substitute) from كل, in the sense that the believer and the disbeliever are both provided for.

mekki-muskil:53-53.t: His saying {وَقل لعبادي يَقُولُوا}: the disagreement about its counterpart in Sūrat Ibrāhīm has passed, and this is like it.

mekki-muskil:57-57.t: His saying {أَيهمْ أقرب}: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). It is also permissible for أيهم to mean الذي, as a badal (substitute) from the wāw in يبتغون; its implied form is "the one of them who is nearest seeks the means". On this assumption أيّ is indeclinable (mabnī) according to Sībawayh; there is disagreement and room for consideration in this, which we will mention in Sūrat Maryam, peace be upon her, if Allah the Exalted wills.

mekki-muskil:59-59.t:
His saying {وَمَا منعنَا أَن نرسل بِالْآيَاتِ إِلَّا أَن كذب}: the first أن is in the position of accusative as the second object of منع, and the second أن is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of منع; its implied form is "nothing prevented Us from sending the signs that Quraysh proposed except the former peoples' denial of their like", and that was the cause of their destruction; had He sent them to Quraysh and they denied them, they would have been destroyed, and it had already been decreed in Allah the Exalted's knowledge that their punishment would be deferred to the Day of Resurrection, so He did not send them for that reason.
His saying {مبصرة}: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

mekki-muskil:6-6.t:
His saying {نفيرا}: accusative as a specification (bayān).
His saying {إِمَّا يبلغن عنْدك}: Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī read it with a doubled nūn and an alif, as a dual (يبلغانّ), because the parents were mentioned before; and the pronoun was repeated in أحدهما by way of emphasis, just as He said أموات and then غير أَحيَاء by way of emphasis; so أحدهما is a badal (substitute) from the pronoun, and أو كلاهما is conjoined to أحدهما. It has also been said that the verb was made dual while it precedes [its agent], according to the dialect of those who say قاما أخواك ("your two brothers stood"), just as the sign of the feminine is retained in a preceding verb by all the Arabs; on this view أحدهما is nominative as the agent of its verb, and كلاهما is conjoined to أحدهما.

mekki-muskil:60-60.t: His saying {والشجرة الملعونة}: الشجرة is accusative by conjunction to الرؤيا, i.e. "and We did not make the vision and the accursed tree [but a trial]".

mekki-muskil:61-61.t:
His saying {خلقت طينا}: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
His saying {يَوْم ندعوا كل أنَاس بإمامهم}: the governor of يوم is a verb indicated by the speech, as though He said "they will not be wronged on the day We call", indicated by His saying وَلَا يظْلمُونَ فتيلا. It is not good for ندعو to govern it, because يوم is annexed to it [Translator's note: the text says "because يوم is a muḍāf ilayhi"], and the muḍāf ilayhi does not govern the muḍāf, since the two are like a single noun, and a thing does not govern itself.
The bāʾ in بإمامهم is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ندعو, in the position of the second object of ندعو, reached by a preposition. It is also permissible for the bāʾ to be attached to an omitted [word], the omitted [word] being in the position of a ḥāl, so the implied form is "We call every people mixed with their leader", i.e. in this state; its meaning is "We call them while their leader is among them". Its meaning according to the first view is "We call them by the name of their leader", and this is the meaning of what is related from Ibn ʿAbbās in his exegesis.
It is related from al-Ḥasan that the imām here is the book in which their deeds are; on this view the bāʾ can only be attached to an omitted [word], which is in the position of a ḥāl; its implied form is "We call them while their book containing their deeds is with them", as though in the implied form it were "We call them with their book established with them" or "settled with them", and the like. On this interpretation ندعو takes only one object.

mekki-muskil:7-7.t:
His saying {وعد الْآخِرَة}: its meaning is "the promise of the last time", then [the noun] was omitted. So it is originally an attribute that has taken the place of the qualified noun, because الآخرة is a naʿt (adjective) of المرة; المرة was omitted and الآخرة was put in its place. The speech refers back to His saying, the Exalted, لتفسدن فِي الأَرْض مرَّتَيْنِ.
His saying {وليتبروا مَا علوا}: مَا with the verb is a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "and to destroy their ascendancy", i.e. the time of their ascendancy, i.e. to ruin and spoil [all] during the time of their power. It is like your saying جئْتُك مقدم الْحَاج وخفوق النَّجْم ("I came to you at the arrival of the pilgrims and the setting of the star"), i.e. at the time of that.

mekki-muskil:72-72.t:
His saying {فَهُوَ فِي الْآخِرَة أعمى}: it is from blindness of the heart, so it is triliteral, from عمي; therefore it came without [an auxiliary] triliteral verb, and it carries the meaning of wonder (taʿajjub). Had it been from blindness of the eye, He would have said "he will be in the Hereafter more intensely blind (أَشد عمى)" or "more evidently blind (أبين عمى)", because it carries the meaning of wonder, and blindness of the eye is a fixed thing, like the hand and the foot, so wonder at it is expressed only by means of a triliteral verb; likewise is the ruling of whatever runs in the manner of wonder.
It has also been said: since blindness of the eye is originally quadriliteral (أعمى), wonder is not expressed at it except by bringing in a triliteral verb, so that the [form of] wonder transfers it to the quadriliteral; and when the verb of the thing wondered at is quadriliteral, it cannot be transferred to more than that, so a triliteral verb must be brought in, such as بان, شدّ, كثر and the like. This is the doctrine of the Basrans. Al-Farrāʾ related مَا أعماه ("how blind he is!") and مَا أعوره ("how one-eyed he is!"), and the Basrans do not permit it.

mekki-muskil:77-77.t: His saying {سنة من قد}: accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. Allah established that as a practice, meaning Allah established that whoever expels his prophet perishes. Al-Farrāʾ said the meaning is "like the practice of those whom (كَسنة من)", and when the kāf was dropped it became accusative.

mekki-muskil:78-78.t: His saying {وَقُرْآن الْفجْر}: accusative by an implied verb, its implied form being "and recite the recitation of dawn"; it has also been said its implied form is "establish the recitation of dawn".

mekki-muskil:8-8.t: His saying {عَسى ربكُم أَن يَرْحَمكُمْ}: أن is in the position of accusative by عسى; the explanation of that has passed. "وال هنا" [Translator's note: so in the text, apparently corrupt; the sense seems to be "and [the mercy] here is"] the sending of Muḥammad ﷺ; and عسى from Allah is a binding certainty, and that indeed came to pass.

mekki-muskil:92-92.t: His saying {قبيلا}: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

mekki-muskil:94-94.t:
His saying {وَمَا منع النَّاس أَن يُؤمنُوا}: أن is in the position of accusative as the second object of منع.
His saying {إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا}: أن is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of منع, i.e. "nothing prevented people from believing except their saying such-and-such".

mekki-muskil:96-96.t: His saying {كفى بِاللَّه شَهِيدا}: Allah, exalted be His mention, is in the position of nominative by كفى, and شهيدا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a specification (bayān); its implied form is "say: Allah suffices as a witness".

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿وإذا قرأت القرآن جعلنا بينك وبين الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة حجابا مستورا﴾: the و is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; إذا is an adverb of future time implying the sense of a condition; ﴿قرأت القرآن﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of genitive (jarr), the adverb being annexed (muḍāf) to it; جعلنا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿بينك﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بين الذين لا يؤمنون﴾ is conjoined to the first adverb; the clause لا يؤمنون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿بالآخرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤمنون﴾; حجابًا is the first object of جعلنا; and مستورًا is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حجابًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿وجعلنا على قلوبهم أكنة أن يفقهوه وفي آذانهم وقرا﴾: جعلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿على قلوبهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object of جعلنا; أكنة is the first object of جعلنا; ﴿أن يفقهوه﴾ is in the accusative position as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of aversion to their understanding it" (كراهة أن يفقهوه), or it is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "from understanding it" (من أن يفقهوه), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أكنة﴾; ﴿في آذانهم وقرا﴾ is conjoined to His words ﴿على قلوبهم أكنة﴾.
﴿وإذا ذكرت ربك في القرآن وحده ولوا على أدبارهم نفورا﴾: the و is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb of future time; ﴿ذكرت﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿ذكرت﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); ربك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في القرآن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ذكرت﴾; ﴿وحده﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿ولوا﴾ has no grammatical position; ﴿على أدبارهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; نفورًا stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is in the meaning of ولَّوا, or it is a ḥāl, i.e. "fleeing" (نافرين); and it is said: it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿نحن أعلم بما يستمعون به إذ يستمعون إليك﴾: نحن is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and أعلم is the khabar (predicate); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; the clause يستمعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يستمعون﴾, and the باء is causal; and it is said: ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), as we say: "they listen with mockery" (يستمعون بالهزء), i.e. "mocking" (هازئين); and it is said: the باء is in the sense of the لام; إذ is an adverb of past time attached to ﴿أعلم﴾ or to the first ﴿يستمعون﴾; and the clause ﴿يستمعون إليك﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وإذ هم نجوى﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb conjoined to the ﴿إذ﴾ in the words of Allah the Exalted ﴿إذ يستمعون﴾, so it is attached to ﴿أعلم﴾ or to the first ﴿يستمعون﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and نجوى is the khabar, on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf; and it is said: there is no need to assume a muḍāf before the khabar; the clause ﴿هم نجوى﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إذ يقول الظالمون إن تتبعون إلا رجلا مسحورا﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a badal (substitute) for the preceding ﴿إذ﴾ in the words of Allah the Exalted ﴿وإذ هم نجوى﴾. ﴿يقول الظالمون﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿يقول الظالمون﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; إن is negating; تتبعون is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the و is the fāʿil; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); رجلًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and مسحورًا is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رجلًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿انظر كيف ضربوا لك الأمثال فضلوا فلا يستطيعون سبيلا﴾: انظر is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); ضربوا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ضربوا﴾; الأمثال is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فضلوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ضربوا﴾, and the فاء is a conjunction; لا is negating; and يستطيعون سبيلًا is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿وقالوا أئذا كنا عظاما ورفاتا﴾: the و is a conjunction; ﴿قالوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); إذا is an adverb of future time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "Shall we be resurrected" (أنبعث), or "Shall we be gathered when we are bones and dust" (نحشر إذا كنا عظامًا ورفاتًا), and the apodosis (jawāb) is the very verb to which it is attached; ﴿كنا﴾ is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism), عظامًا is its khabar (predicate), and رفاتًا is conjoined to ﴿عظامًا﴾.
﴿أئنا لمبعوثون خلقا جديدا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and مبعوثون is the khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿خلقا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "created" (مخلوقين), or it stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), from the meaning of the verb and not its wording, i.e. "we shall be raised with a new raising" (نبعث بعثا جديدا); and ﴿جديدا﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿قل كونوا حجارة أو حديدا﴾: قل is an imperative verb; ﴿كونوا﴾ is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) imperative verb, the و is its noun (ism), and حجارة is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿كونوا حجارة﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction, and حديدًا is conjoined to حجارة.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿أو خلقا مما يكبر في صدوركم﴾: أو is a conjunction; خلقًا is conjoined to حجارة; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿خلقًا﴾; the clause يكبر is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿في صدوركم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يكبر﴾.
﴿فسيقولون من يعيدنا﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; the سين is a particle of the future; يقولون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); من is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause يعيدنا is the khabar (predicate).
﴿قل الذي فطركم أول مرة﴾: ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb; الذي فطركم is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "will bring you back" (يعيدكم), or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "He is the One who created you" (هو الذي فطركم); the clause فطركم is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position; and ﴿أول مرة﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿فطركم﴾.
﴿فسينغضون إليك رءوسهم ويقولون متى هو﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; the سين is for the future; ينغضون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; ﴿إليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينغضون﴾; رءوسهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿يقولون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ينغضون﴾; متى is an interrogative noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; and ﴿هو﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿قل عسى أن يكون قريبا﴾: عسى is one of the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ), and its noun (ism) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هو); أن together with what follows it is in the position of accusative as the khabar of عسى; the noun of يكون is latent, its implied form being "it" (هو), and قريبًا is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿يوم يدعوكم فتستجيبون بحمده﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر) or "remember (pl.)" (اذكروا); the clause ﴿يدعوكم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿فتستجيبون﴾ is conjoined to يدعوكم; and ﴿بحمده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "praising" (حامدين).
﴿وتظنون إن لبثتم إلا قليلا﴾: the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿تظنون﴾ is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إن﴾ is negating; ﴿لبثتم﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿قليلًا﴾ stands in place of an adverb of time, attached to ﴿لبثتم﴾, i.e. "a little time" (زمنًا قليلا), or it stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is its adjective, i.e. "a little tarrying" (لبثًا قليلًا).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿وقل لعبادي يقولوا التي هي أحسن﴾: the و is resumptive; ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿لعبادي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قل﴾; ﴿يقولوا﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by an implied lām of command, the omission of the lām being permissible because ﴿قُل﴾ indicates the command; and the و of the plural is the fāʿil.
Or: ﴿يقولوا﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive as the answer to the command ﴿قُل﴾, and the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl) is omitted, the implied form being: "Say to My servants, 'Say that which is best,' and they will say that which is best" (قل لعبادي قولوا التي هي أحسن يقولوا التي هي أحسن).
Or: ﴿يقولوا﴾ is an imperfect verb turned from command to statement, its meaning being ﴿قولوا﴾, and it was made indeclinable (mabnī) because it occurs in the place of an indeclinable form, so its nūn was dropped.
﴿التي﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يقولوا﴾, or an adjective of an omitted object, i.e. "let them say the word which is best" (يقولوا الكلمةَ التي هي أحسن); ﴿هي﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿أحسن﴾ is the khabar (predicate), and the clause ﴿هي أحسن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الشيطان ينزغ بينهم﴾: the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) for His words ﴿يقولوا التي هي أحسن﴾; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ﴿الشيطان﴾ is the noun (ism) of إن, and the clause ﴿ينزغ بينهم﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن.
﴿إن الشيطان كان للإنسان عدوا مبينا﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle and ﴿الشيطان﴾ is the noun of إن; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb; ﴿للإنسان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عدوًّا﴾; ﴿عدوًّا﴾ is the khabar of كان, and ﴿مبينًا﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿عدوًّا﴾; the clause ﴿كان للإنسان عدوا مبينا﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن, and the clause ﴿إن الشيطان كان للإنسان عدوا مبينا﴾ gives the reason for the clause ﴿ينزغ بينهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿ربكم أعلم بكم إن يشأ يرحمكم﴾: ربكم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and أعلم is the khabar (predicate); ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; إن is conditional; ﴿يشأ﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), in the jussive (majzūm); and يرحمكم is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), also in the jussive.
﴿أو إن يشأ يعذبكم﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿وما أرسلناك عليهم وكيلا﴾: the و is a conjunction; ما is negating; أرسلناك is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وكيلًا﴾; and وكيلًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the كاف.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿وربك أعلم بمن في السماوات والأرض﴾: the و is a conjunction; ربك is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and أعلم is the khabar (predicate); ﴿بمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; and ﴿في السماوات والأرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولقد فضلنا بعض النبيين على بعض وآتينا داود زبورا﴾: the و is a conjunction; the لام occurs in the answer to an implied oath; قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); فضلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); بعض النبيين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على بعض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فضلنا﴾; آتينا is a verb and its fāʿil, conjoined to ﴿فضلنا﴾; داود is the first mafʿūl bihi, and زبورًا is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿قل ادعوا الذين زعمتم من دونه﴾: the clause ﴿ادعوا الذين﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ادعوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); الذين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause زعمتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the two objects of ﴿زعمتم﴾ are omitted because they are known, the implied form being "you claimed them to be gods" (زعمتموهم آلهة); and ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فلا يملكون كشف الضر عنكم ولا تحويلا﴾: the فاء is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لا is negating; يملكون كشف الضر is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عنكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كشف﴾; the و is a conjunction, لا is negating, and تحويلًا is conjoined to كشف الضر.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿أولئك الذين يدعون يبتغون إلى ربهم الوسيلة﴾: أولئك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الذين يدعون is a badal (substitute) for it; the clause يبتغون is the khabar (predicate), and the و is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى ربهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿الوسيلة﴾; الوسيلة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); or ﴿الذين﴾ is the khabar, and the clause يبتغون is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يدعون.
﴿أيهم أقرب ويرجون رحمته ويخافون عذابه﴾: ﴿أيهم﴾ is a badal for the fāʿil of يبتغون, and ﴿أي﴾ is relative (mawṣūla), and أقرب is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; and it is said: ﴿أي﴾ is interrogative, a mubtadaʾ, and أقرب is the khabar, the meaning being: they look to see which of them is nearest and seek a means through him, on the assumption of a suppressed verb of suspension (taʿlīq), and ﴿أيهم أقرب﴾ is in the accusative position by the dropping of the preposition; ويرجون رحمته is conjoined to يبتغون; يرجون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and رحمته is the mafʿūl bihi; and ويخافون عذابه is conjoined to يرجون رحمته.
﴿إن عذاب ربك كان محذورا﴾: the reason for the fear; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, عذاب is its noun (ism), and the clause كان is its khabar; كان is a defective, abrogating past verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو), and محذورًا is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿وإن من قرية إلا نحن مهلكوها قبل يوم القيامة أو معذبوها عذابا شديدا﴾: the و is resumptive; إن is negating; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; قرية is a mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in form and nominative in position; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); نحن is a mubtadaʾ and مهلكوها is its khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is the khabar of قرية; in ﴿قبل يوم القيامة﴾ the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مهلكوها﴾; the clause ﴿وإن من قرية...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction, and معذبوها is conjoined to ﴿مهلكوها﴾; عذابا stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); and شديدًا is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿كان ذلك في الكتاب مسطورا﴾: كان is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and ذلك is its noun (ism); ﴿في الكتاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مسطورًا﴾; and مسطورًا is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿وما منعنا أن نرسل بالآيات إلا أن كذب بها الأولون﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ما is negating; منعنا is a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أن نرسل﴾ is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), the second object of ﴿منع﴾; in ﴿بالآيات﴾ the باء is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, or a genuine one denoting accompaniment (mulābasa), the object being omitted, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the meaning being: "Nothing prevented Us from sending a prophet in the state of being accompanied by the signs"; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the second أن and what falls within its scope are in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of منع; ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كذب﴾; and الأولون is the fāʿil.
﴿وآتينا ثمود الناقة مبصرة فظلموا بها﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; آتينا is a verb and its fāʿil; ثمود is the first mafʿūl bihi, and الناقة is the second mafʿūl bihi; مبصرة is a ḥāl; in ﴿فظلموا﴾ the فاء is a conjunction, and ظلموا is a verb and its fāʿil; and ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it.
﴿وما نرسل بالآيات إلا تخويفا﴾: the و is circumstantial; ما is negating; نرسل is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil; in ﴿بالآيات﴾ the باء is a connective (redundant) preposition, or a genuine one denoting accompaniment; إلا is a particle of restriction; and تخويفًا is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or a maṣdar in the accusative position as a ḥāl, either from the fāʿil, i.e. "frightening by means of them" (مخوفين بها), or from the object, i.e. "made a means of frightening" (مخوفًا بها).

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿وإذ قلنا لك إن ربك أحاط بالناس﴾: the و is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); the clause ﴿قلنا﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ربك is its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿أحاط بالناس﴾ is its khabar (predicate).
﴿وما جعلنا الرؤيا التي أريناك إلا فتنة للناس﴾: the و is a conjunction; ما is negating; جعلنا الرؤيا is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi; أريناك is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); فتنة is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿جعلنا﴾; and ﴿للناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿فتنة﴾.
﴿والشجرة الملعونة في القرآن﴾: conjoined to الرؤيا; ﴿الملعونة﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of it; and ﴿في القرآن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ونخوفهم فما يزيدهم إلا طغيانا كبيرا﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; نخوفهم is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; in ﴿فما﴾ the فاء is a conjunction and ما is negating; يزيدهم is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "Our frightening" (تخويفنا); إلا is a particle of restriction; طغيانًا is the second mafʿūl bihi; and كبيرًا is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿وإذ قلنا للملائكة اسجدوا لآدم فسجدوا إلا إبليس﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); ﴿قلنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿قلنا﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿للملائكة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قلنا﴾; اسجدوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the و is the fāʿil, and the verbal clause is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿لآدم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اسجدوا﴾; in ﴿فسجدوا﴾ the فاء is a conjunction, and سجدوا is a verb and its fāʿil; إلا is a particle of exception; إبليس is excepted (mustathnā) by ﴿إلا﴾, the exception being connected (muttaṣil), on the view that Iblīs was originally of the angels; and it is said: it is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), because he is not of them.
﴿قال أأسجد لمن خلقت طينا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); ﴿لمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أسجد﴾; the clause خلقت is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; طينًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun, its governing word (ʿāmil) being ﴿أأسجد﴾, or from the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) of this relative noun, i.e. "You created him as clay" (خلقته طينًا), so that its governing word is خلقته, as though he said: "originating from clay" (متأصلًا من طين); and it is said: it is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "from clay" (من طين); and it is said: it is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿قال أرأيتك هذا الذي كرمت علي﴾: in ﴿أرأيتك﴾ the hamza is interrogative; رأى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; the تاء is the fāʿil (agent); the كاف is for emphasising the address and has no grammatical position; ﴿هذا﴾ is the first object; the relative noun is an adjective (ṣifa) or a badal (substitute) of it; and the second object is omitted because the ṣila (relative clause) indicates it, i.e. "Tell me about this one whom You have honoured above me by commanding me to prostrate to him: why have You honoured him above me?"
﴿لئن أخرتن إلى يوم القيامة لأحتنكن ذريته إلا قليلا﴾: the لام paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; أخرتني is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the nūn being the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿إلى يوم القيامة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخرتني﴾; in ﴿لأحتنكن﴾ the لام occurs in the answer to the oath, and أحتنكن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); ذريته is the mafʿūl bihi; إلا is a particle of exception, and قليلًا is excepted from ﴿ذريته﴾, in the accusative; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the answer to the oath indicates it.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿قال اذهب فمن تبعك منهم﴾: اذهب is an imperative verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); in ﴿فمن﴾ the فاء is resumptive, and من is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject); تبعك is a past verb, the fāʿil is latent, and the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿تبعك﴾ is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); and ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فإن جهنم جزاؤكم جزاء موفورا﴾: the فاء links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, جهنم is its noun (ism), and جزاؤكم is its khabar (predicate); جزاء is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of a verb indicated by جزاؤكم, i.e. "you will be recompensed with a recompense" (تجزون جزاء), or it is made accusative by the maṣdar; and it is said: it is a preparatory ḥāl (ḥāl muwaṭṭiʾa); and it is said: a tamyīz (specification); موفورًا is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿فمن تبعك...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿واستفزز من استطعت منهم بصوتك وأجلب عليهم بخيلك ورجلك﴾: the و is a conjunction; استفزز is a second command to Satan; ﴿من﴾ is a relative noun, the object of استفزز; the clause استطعت is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position, and the object of استطعت is omitted, its implied form being "whomever you are able to incite" (من استطعت أن تستفزه); ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿بصوتك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استفزز﴾; أجلب is a third command; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿بخيلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أجلب﴾; and رجلك is conjoined to بخيلك.
﴿وشاركهم في الأموال والأولاد وعدهم﴾: ﴿وشاركهم في﴾ is a fourth command, and the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في الأموال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شاركهم﴾; ﴿عدهم﴾ is a fifth command, and the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وما يعدهم الشيطان إلا غرورا﴾: the و is circumstantial or parenthetical; ما is negating; يعدهم الشيطان is an imperfect verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi and a postponed fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); غرورًا is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "except a deluding promise" (إلا وعدًا غرورًا); and it is said: it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "he does not promise them and raise their hopes except for the sake of delusion"; and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, or it is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿إن عبادي ليس لك عليهم سلطان وكفى بربك وكيلا﴾: an explanatory (taʿlīliyya) clause for the command to promise, i.e. "We only command you to do that because We know that you have no authority over Our righteous servants"; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, عبادي is its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿ليس﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar of ﴿ليس﴾; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of سلطان; سلطان is the postponed noun of ليس; كفى is a past verb, the باء is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) on the fāʿil (agent); and وكيلًا is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿ربكم الذي يزجي لكم الفلك في البحر﴾: the clause is an explanation (taʿlīl) setting out the power of Allah the Exalted; ربكم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and الذي is its khabar (predicate); the clause يزجي is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يزجي﴾; الفلك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿في البحر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لتبتغوا من فضله﴾: the لام is causal (lām al-taʿlīl); تبتغوا is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the causal lām; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تبتغوا﴾, i.e. "that you may seek profit from His bounty".
﴿إنه كان بكم رحيما﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the هاء is its noun (ism), and the clause كان is its khabar; كان is a defective, abrogating past verb; ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رحيمًا﴾; and رحيمًا is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿وإذا مسكم الضر في البحر ضل من تدعون إلا إياه﴾: the و is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb of future time implying the sense of a condition; the clause مسكم is muḍāf ilayhi; the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and الضر is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿في البحر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "while you are at sea"; the clause ضل has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; ﴿مَن﴾ is the fāʿil of ﴿ضل﴾; the clause تدعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿إلا إياه﴾ is a connected (muttaṣil) exception; and it is said: disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), i.e. "the gods you call upon fail to come to your aid, but Allah alone is the One in whom alone you place your hope".
﴿فلما نجاكم إلى البر أعرضتم وكان الإنسان كفورا﴾: لما is a non-jussive conditional particle; نجاكم is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil being latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); ﴿إلى البر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نجاكم﴾; أعرضتم is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); كان is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, الإنسان is its noun (ism), and كفورا is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿أفأمنتم أن يخسف بكم جانب البر﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and the فاء conjoins to something omitted, its implied form being: "Were you saved, and so felt secure, and did your rescue lead you to turn away?"; أمنتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿أن يخسف﴾ is an interpreted maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "from His causing to swallow" (من أن يخسف), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أمنتم﴾; ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied by you", so the باء is for accompaniment, or the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يخسف﴾, and the باء is causal; and ﴿جانب البر﴾ is the object of يخسف.
﴿أو يرسل عليكم حاصبا﴾: أو is a conjunction; يرسل is conjoined to يخسف; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرسل﴾; and حاصبًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
