The clause «أرسلناك ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
106- (الواو) a conjunction; (قرآنا) mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb explained by what follows [Note: and it cannot be a ḥāl except of the pronoun referring to the Qurʾān alone.]; (فرقناه) like أنزلناه; (اللام) causal (taʿlīl); (تقرأه) an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» concealed after the lām... and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is «أنت»; (على الناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تقرأه); (على مكث) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تقرأ, i.e. "unhurriedly".
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تقرأه..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (فرقناه).
(الواو) the wāw of ḥāl; (نزّلناه) like أنزلناه; (تنزيلا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative.
The clause «(فرقنا) قرآنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أنزلناه.
The clause «فرقناه ...» has no grammatical position: explicative (tafsīriyya).
The clause «تقرأه ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the concealed particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «نزّلناه ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) implied.

* Morphology:
(مكث): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral verb مكث, of the pattern-class نصر, meaning "prolonging in duration"; its wazn is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn; it also comes with fatḥa, and it has been read so, and with kasra, though it has not been read so.
(تنزيلا): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb نزّل; its wazn is تفعيل.

* Rhetoric:
1- Explicit mention (al-dhikr), or explicitness (al-taṣrīḥ):
In the words of the Exalted: «وَبِالْحَقِّ أَنْزَلْناهُ وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَ».
Had the overt noun been abandoned in favour of a pronoun, as the context would require, saying:
«وبالحق أنزلناه وبه نزل», it would not have had the grandeur it has now. Some call this al-taṣrīḥ (explicitness).
2- The art of digression (al-istiṭrād):
In the words of the Exalted «وَبِالْحَقِّ أَنْزَلْناهُ وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَ».
It is a return to describing the state of the noble Qurʾān, so it is connected with the words of the Exalted «لَئِنِ اجْتَمَعَتِ الْإِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ», the verse. Such is the way of the Arabs in their speech: they take up one thing, digress from it to another, then to another, then to another, and then return to what they mentioned first.
3- Restriction (al-qaṣr):
In the words of the Exalted «وَما أَرْسَلْناكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّراً وَنَذِيراً».
In the speech there is relative restriction (qaṣr iḍāfī). Restriction is: assigning one thing exclusively to another, by a specific means.
It is divided into real (ḥaqīqī) and relative (iḍāfī). The real is that in which the exclusiveness is according to fact and reality, not in relation to something else, as in «لا كاتب في المدينة إلا علي» ("there is no scribe in the city except ʿAlī"), when there is no other scribe in it. The relative is that in which the exclusiveness is in relation to a specific thing, as in «ما علي إلا قائم» ("ʿAlī is only standing"), i.e. he has the quality of standing, not the quality of sitting.

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta" (لعبادي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قل), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (يقولوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (التي) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: It is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun, i.e.: let them say the word which is best.], (هي) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject) (أحسن) khabar (predicate), nominative (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb (الشيطان) the noun of إنّ, accusative (ينزغ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "huwa" (بينهم) an adverb (ẓarf), accusative, attached to (ينزغ), (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (إنّ الشيطان) like the first (كان) a past defective verb, its noun being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (للإنسان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عدوّا), the khabar of كان, accusative (مبينا) naʿt of (عدوّا), accusative.
The clause «قل ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يقولوا ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ, i.e.: if you ask them, they will say ... and the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of (قل) is omitted, i.e. what you want to say.
The clause «هي أحسن ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (التي).
The clause «إنّ الشيطان ينزغ ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīl) for (يقولوا) [Note: In reality the thing explained is omitted, known from the context, i.e.: and let them not say speech that is harsh on souls, because Satan ...].
The clause «ينزغ ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «إنّ الشيطان كان ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason for (ينزغ).
The clause «كان للإنسان ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the second إنّ.

safi-cedvel:54-55.t:
* I'rab:
(ربّكم) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (أعلم) khabar (predicate), nominative (الباء) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعلم) (إن) a conditional particle that puts into the jussive (يشأ) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa" (يرحمكم) like يشأ, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (أو) a conjunction (ان يشأ يعذّبكم) like إن يشأ يرحمكم (الواو) parenthetical (ما) negating (أرسلناك) a past verb and its fāʿil, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (أرسلناك), (وكيلا) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb).
The clause «ربّكم أعلم ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: or it is in the position of an accusative, a badal (substitute) of the relative noun (التي), i.e. the word which is best is His saying: ربّكم أعلم.. and what lies between the badal and the one it replaces is a parenthesis.].
The clause «إن يشأ ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يرحمكم ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of the condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إن يشأ (the second)» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إن يشأ (the first).
The clause «يعذّبكم ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of the second condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ما أرسلناك ...» has no grammatical position, parenthetical [Note: or conjoined to the resumptive clause.].
55- (الواو) a conjunction (ربّك أعلم) like ربّكم أعلم (الباء) a preposition (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive, attached to (أعلم) (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of من (الأرض) conjoined to السموات by the wāw, genitive like it (الواو) a conjunction (اللام) the lām of oath for an implied oath (قد) a particle of verification (taḥqīq) (فضّلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (بعض) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (النبيّين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ (على بعض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فضّلنا), (الواو) a conjunction (آتينا) like فضّلنا (داود) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, barred from tanwīn because of being a proper name and foreign (ʿujma) (زبورا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «ربّك أعلم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ربّكم أعلم.
The clause «قد فضّلنا ...» has no grammatical position, the answer to the implied oath.. and the implied oath clause is conjoined to the clause ربّك أعلم, with no grammatical position.
The clause «آتينا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that answers the oath.

* Morphology:
(زبورا): the Book that was sent down to David; its pattern is فعول, either in the sense of the passive participle, like حلوب, or it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in its sense, like القبول. It is read with fatḥa and with ḍamma on the zāy, and it came in the indefinite form because it is one book among the books.

safi-cedvel:56-57.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta" (ادعوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (زعمتم) a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn.. and (تم) is a pronoun, fāʿil..
and the two objects of the verb are omitted, i.e. you claimed them to be gods (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative (الذين) [Note: The governor of the ḥāl is the verb ادعوا.. It is far-fetched to attach the preposition to a ḥāl of the implied first object, because the governor would then become the verb زعمتم, and the polytheists did not claim the gods to be worshipped apart from Allah, but rather [claimed] that they are partners with Him.].. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition (لا) negating (يملكون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (كشف) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (الضرّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) (عن) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the maṣdar كشف (الواو) a conjunction (لا) redundant (zāʾida), for emphasizing the negation (تحويلا) conjoined to كشف, accusative.
The clause «قل ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ادعوا ...» is in the position of an accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «زعمتم ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا يملكون ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "hum"..
and the nominal clause is in the position of a jussive (majzūm), the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the implied condition, i.e. if you call them, then they do not possess.
57- (أولئك) a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ [Note: The reference is to the rational gods, such as Jesus, ʿUzayr and the angels.. and the non-rational ones.], (الذين) a relative noun in the position of a nominative, badal (substitute) of the demonstrative — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — (يدعون) like يملكون, and the resumptive pronoun of the relative is omitted, i.e. they call them gods (يبتغون) like يملكون (إلى ربهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يبتغون), (الوسيلة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (أيّهم) a relative noun, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of a nominative, badal of the agent of يبتغون [Note: The interpreted (أيّ) came indeclinable because it is annexed and the head of its ṣila has been omitted.. It may be an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is أقرب.].. and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (أقرب) the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "huwa", nominative (الواو) a conjunction in both places (يرجون رحمته، يخافون عذابه) like يملكون كشف الضرّ (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative (عذاب) the noun of إنّ, accusative (ربّك) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (كان) a past defective verb, its noun being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (محذورا) khabar, accusative.
The clause «أولئك الذين ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يدعون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يبتغون ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك) [Note: The clause may be a ḥāl of the agent of يدعون if the khabar of the mubtadaʾ is the relative (الذين).
(4, 5) or in the position of an accusative.].
The clause «(هو) أقرب ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (أيّ).
The clause «يرجون ...» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause يبتغون «4».
The clause «يخافون ...» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause يبتغون «5».
The clause «إنّ عذاب ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «كان محذورا ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(كشف): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral verb كشف; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(تحويلا): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb حوّل; its pattern is تفعيل.
(يبتغون): it contains a change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf) and a change by quiescence (iʿlāl bi-l-taskīn); its original form is يبتغيون — with ḍamma on the second yāʾ — the ḍamma was felt heavy on the yāʾ, so it was moved to the ghayn and the yāʾ was made quiescent — iʿlāl bi-l-taskīn — then the yāʾ was dropped because it met, quiescent, with the wāw of the plural, so it became يبتغون; its pattern is يفتعون.
(محذورا): a passive participle from the triliteral حذر; its pattern is مفعول.

* Benefits:
- أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ.
The grammarians summarized the ways in which «أي» comes, and they were six:
1- Conditional: «أَيًّا ما تَدْعُوا فَلَهُ الْأَسْماءُ الْحُسْنى», as shown by the jussive of تدعو and the entry of the linking fāʾ in its apodosis.
2- Interrogative: «أَيُّكُمْ زادَتْهُ هذِهِ إِيماناً»..?
3- Relative: «لَنَنْزِعَنَّ مِنْ كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ».
4- Indicating perfection, as in: زيد رجل أي رجل? ("Zayd is a man — what a man!")
5- Being a link for addressing in the vocative what has «ال», as in: يا أيها الرجل.
6- Being for exclamation: سبحان الله أي رجل هذا! ("Glory be to Allah, what a man this is!") It is declinable (muʿrab) in all its states, except when it is relative, annexed, and the head of its ṣila is omitted, in which case it is indeclinable on ḍamma. It has detailed treatment in the extensive works.

safi-cedvel:58-59.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (إن) negating (من) redundant (zāʾida) (قرية) genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, mubtadaʾ (subject) (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) (نحن) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (مهلكوها) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.. and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (قبل) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (مهلكوها), (يوم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (أو) a conjunction (معذّبوها) conjoined to (مهلكوها), parsed like it (عذابا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, its governor being the active participle معذوبها [Translator's note: so spelled in the source; معذّبوها is meant] (شديدا) naʿt (adjective) of (عذابا), accusative (كان ... مسطورا) like كان محذورا [Note: in the preceding verse (57).], (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative, the noun of كان.. and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address (في الكتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مسطورا).
The clause «إن من قرية ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «نحن مهلكوها ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (قرية).
The clause «كان ذلك ... مسطورا» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
59- (الواو) a conjunction (ما) negating (منعنا) a past verb, and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative particle (نرسل) an imperfect verb, accusative, and the fāʿil (agent) is "naḥnu", for majesty (بالآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied object of نرسل, i.e. "We send a prophet bearing the signs" [Note: The bāʾ may be a redundant preposition.. and الآيات the object of نرسل.]; and the interpreted maṣdar (أن نرسل ...) is in the position of a genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to (منعنا), i.e. "prevented Us from sending" (إلّا) a particle of restriction (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle (كذّب) a past verb (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (كذّب), (الأوّلون) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن كذّب ...) is in the position of a nominative, the fāʿil of منع (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) (آتينا) a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn.. and (نا) is a pronoun, fāʿil (ثمود) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative, barred from tanwīn because of being a proper name and foreign (ʿujma) [Translator's note: so in the source; ثمود is usually treated as a diptote for being a proper name and feminine (a tribe).] (الناقة) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (مبصرة) ḥāl, accusative (الفاء) a conjunction (ظلموا) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (ظلموا) by its being made to contain the meaning of كفروا ("they disbelieved") (الواو) a conjunction (ما) negating (نرسل بالآيات) like the first, and the verb is nominative.. (إلّا) like the first (تخويفا) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative [Note: It may be a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl of the agent, i.e. "warning" — مخوّفين with kasra on the wāw — or of the object, i.e. "warned by them".].
The clause «ما منعنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إن من قرية ...
The clause «نرسل ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أنّ) [Translator's note: so in the source, with shadda; أن is meant].
The clause «كذّب بها الأوّلون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second particle-relative (أن).
The clause «آتينا ...» has no grammatical position, parenthetical [Note: or in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl, with (قد) implied.].
The clause «ظلموا بها ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the parenthetical clause.
The clause «ما نرسل بالآيات إلّا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause منعنا.

* Morphology:
(مهلكوها): in the plural form for majesty; its singular is مهلك.. see verse (164) of Surat al-Aʿrāf.
(معذّبوها): in the plural form for majesty; its singular is معذّب.. see verse (164) of Surat al-Aʿrāf.
(مسطورا): a passive participle from the triliteral سطر; its pattern is مفعول.
(تخويفا): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb خوّف; its pattern is تفعيل.

* Rhetoric:
1- Figurative attribution (al-isnād al-majāzī):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «وَما مَنَعَنا أَنْ نُرْسِلَ بِالْآياتِ».
Prevention is impossible with respect to Him, exalted is He, because nothing prevents Allah from His will. So "prevention" is a figure for "leaving off", i.e. the cause of leaving off the sending of the signs was nothing but the denial of the earlier peoples.
2- Rational figure (al-majāz al-ʿaqlī):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «النَّاقَةَ مُبْصِرَةً».
Since the she-camel was a cause of seeing the truth and guidance, seeing was attributed to her; so there is a majāz ʿaqlī in it, whose relation is causality.

safi-cedvel:107-109.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb; the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت»; (آمنوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (الباء) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنوا); (أو) a conjunction; (لا) the jussive lā of prohibition; (تؤمنوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and the second (به) is implied (muqaddar); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ; (أوتوا) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, passive... and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (العلم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (من قبله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أوتوا), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis يخرّون; (يتلى) an imperfect verb, passive... and the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو», i.e. the Qurʾān; (على) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يتلى); (يخرّون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ)... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (للأذقان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يخرّون) by making it carry the sense of «يذلّون» ("they humble themselves") [Note: or the lām means «على», i.e. "they fall upon their faces"... The preposition phrase may also be attached to (سجّدا).]; (سجّدا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا به ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لا تؤمنوا ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «إنّ الذين أوتوا ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «أوتوا العلم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «the condition, its verb and its apodosis» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «يتلى ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يخرّون ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
108- (الواو) a conjunction — or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) —; (يقولون) like يخرّون; (سبحان) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; (ربّنا) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr)... and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إن) lightened from the heavy (إنّ), necessarily inoperative; (كان) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) —; (وعد) the noun of كان, nominative; (ربّنا) like the first; (اللام) the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa); (مفعولا) the khabar of كان, accusative.
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يخرّون [Note: or it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يخرّون, i.e. "they fall down while saying..."].
The clause «(نسبح) سبحان ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical, of supplication.
The clause «كان وعد ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
109- (الواو) a conjunction; (يخرّون للأذقان) like the first; (يبكون) like يخرّون; (الواو) a conjunction — or circumstantial —; (يزيدهم) an imperfect verb, nominative... and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is «هو», i.e. the Qurʾān, or the weeping, or the prostration...; (خشوعا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «يخرّون (the second)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يخرّون (the first).
The clause «يبكون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يخرّون.
The clause «يزيدهم ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يبكون [Note: or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يبكون.].

* Morphology:
(الأذقان): plural of ذقن, a non-derived (jāmid) noun for the well-known body part (the chin); its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, and the wazn of أذقان is أفعال.
(خشوعا): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral verb خشع, of the pattern-class فتح; its wazn is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:110-111.t:
* I'rab:
(قل ادعوا) like «قل آمنوا» [Note: in verse (107) of this surah.]; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أو) a conjunction; (ادعوا الرحمن) like «ادعوا الله»; (أيّا) a jussive conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (ما) redundant (zāʾida); (تدعوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اللام) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a khabar (predicate) placed first; (الأسماء) a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after, nominative (marfūʿ); (الحسنى) a naʿt (adjective) of الأسماء, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) the jussive lā of prohibition; (تجهر) an imperfect verb, jussive; the fāʿil is «أنت»; (بصلاتك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجهر), and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) a conjunction; (لا تخافت) like «لا تجهر»; (الباء) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تخافت); (الواو) a conjunction; (ابتغ) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is «أنت»; (بين) an adverb, accusative, attached to (سبيلا) [Note: or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (سبيلا) — an adjective placed before what it qualifies —.], which is the mafʿūl bihi.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ادعوا الله ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ادعوا الرحمن ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause «ادعوا الله».
The clause «تدعوا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «له الأسماء ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لا تجهر ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause قل.
The clause «لا تخافت ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «لا تجهر».
The clause «ابتغ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «لا تجهر».
111- (الواو) a conjunction; (قل) like the first; (الحمد) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (الذي) a relative, in the position of genitive as a naʿt of the Name of Majesty; (لم) a particle of negation and of the jussive; (يتّخذ) an imperfect verb, jussive; the fāʿil is «هو»; (ولدا) second mafʿūl bihi [Note: the first object is implied, i.e. "He has not taken anyone as a son".], accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (لم) like the first; (يكن) a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive; (له) like the first, attached to the khabar of كان; (شريك) the noun of كان, nominative; (في الملك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (شريك); (الواو) a conjunction; (لم يكن له وليّ) like «لم يكن له شريك»; (من الذلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (وليّ), and من is causal, i.e. "on account of humiliation"; (الواو) a conjunction; (كبّره) an imperative verb... and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is «أنت»; (تكبيرا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «قل ادعوا ...».
The clause «الحمد لله ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «لم يتّخذ ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «لم يكن له شريك ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «لم يكن له وليّ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «كبّره ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «قل..».

* Morphology:
(ابتغ): it contains iʿlāl by deletion, in conformity with the indeclinable (imperative) form; its wazn is افتع.
(تكبيرا): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb كبّر; its wazn is تفعيل.

* Benefits:
1- The Most Beautiful Names of Allah:
The jurists are agreed that Allah has ninety-nine names, and they are as follows:
هو الله الذي لا إله إلا هو الرحمن الرحيم الملك القدوس السلام المؤمن المهيمن العزيز الجبار المتكبر الخالق البارئ المصور الغفار القهار الوهاب الرزاق الفتاح العليم القابض الباسط الخافض الرافع المعز المذل السميع البصير الحكم العدل اللطيف الخبير الحليم العظيم الغفور الشكور العلي الكبير الحفيظ المقيت الحسيب الخليل [Translator's note: so printed; the well-known list has «الجليل» here.] الكريم الرقيب المجيب الواسع الحكيم الودود المجيد الباعث الشهيد الحق الوكيل القوي المتين الولي الحميد المحصي المبدئ المعيد المحيي المميت الحي القيوم الواجد الماجد الواحد الأحد الصمد القادر المقتدر المقدم المؤخر الأول الآخر الباطن الظاهر الوالي المتعالي البر التواب المنتقم العفو الرؤوف، مالك الملك ذو الجلال والإكرام المقسط الجامع الغني المغني المانع الضار النافع النور الهادي البديع الباقي الوارث الرشيد الصبور.
2- The bewilderment of Quraysh before the Qurʾān:
Among what history has preserved for us is that Abū Jahl, Abū Sufyān and al-Akhnas went out one night to listen to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was praying at night in his house. Each of them took a place to listen in, without his two companions seeing him. They spent the night listening until dawn broke; they dispersed, and the road brought them together. They blamed one another, and some said to others: "Do not go back to the like of this; if your foolish ones saw you, you would plant something in their souls." Then they departed. When the second night came, they went back to what they had done the previous night. Then they departed and met on the road, and said what they had said the first time. When the third night came, they went back and listened, then departed, met and reproached one another, and then made a pact not to go back to the like of it....!
When morning came, al-Akhnas took his staff and went out until he came to Abū Sufyān in his house, and said to him: "Tell me, O Abū Ḥanẓala, your opinion of what you heard." He said: "O Abū Thaʿlaba, by Allah, I heard things that I recognize and know what is meant by them, and I heard things whose meaning I did not know, nor what is meant by them." Al-Akhnas said:
"And I, by the One by whom I swore, am the same."
Then he left him and came to Abū Jahl, and said to him: "O Abū al-Ḥakam, what is your opinion of what you heard from Muḥammad?" He said: "What did I hear? We and the Banū ʿAbd Manāf contended for honour: they fed, so we fed; they gave, so we gave; until, when we were knee to knee and were like two racehorses, they said:
'From us is a prophet to whom revelation comes from heaven.' So when shall we attain the like of this... By Allah, we will never believe in him nor accept him as truthful"

safi-cedvel:60-60.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (إذ) an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر ("remember") (قلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent) (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — (ربّك) the noun of إنّ, accusative, and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (أحاط) a past verb, and the fāʿil is "huwa" (بالناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أحاط), (الواو) a conjunction (ما) negating (جعلنا) like قلنا (الرؤيا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif (التي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, naʿt (adjective) of الرؤيا (أريناك) like قلنا..
and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) (فتنة) second mafʿūl bihi of the verb جعلنا, accusative (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of (فتنة) [Note: or attached to فتنة.. or it is the lām of strengthening (lām al-taqwiya), redundant (zāʾida), and the noun it puts in the genitive is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi.], (الشجرة) conjoined to الرؤيا by the wāw, accusative (الملعونة) naʿt of الشجرة, accusative (في القرآن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (الملعونة) (الواو) a conjunction (نخوّفهم) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "naḥnu", for majesty (الفاء) a conjunction (ما) negating (يزيدهم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (هم) is like the last, and the fāʿil is "huwa", i.e. the warning (إلّا) like the first (طغيانا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (كبيرا) naʿt of (طغيانا), accusative.
The clause «قلنا ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «إنّ ربّك ...» is in the position of an accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أحاط ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «ما جعلنا ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, conjoined to the implied resumptive clause, namely the clause اذكر.
The clause «أريناك ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (التي).
The clause «نخوّفهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «ما يزيدهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نخوّفهم.

* Morphology:
(الرؤيا): it is sight with the eyes, not a dream-vision, because this seeing took place when the noble Messenger was taken by night and ascended to heaven, and that happened while awake, not in sleep.
(الملعونة): feminine of الملعون, a passive participle from the triliteral لعن; its pattern is مفعولة.

safi-cedvel:61-61.t:
* I'rab:
(وإذ قلنا للملائكة) like وإذ قلنا لك [Note: in the preceding verse (60).], (اسجدوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent) (لآدم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اسجدوا), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa (الفاء) a conjunction (سجدوا) a past verb and its fāʿil (إلّا) for exception (إبليس) excepted by إلّا, accusative (manṣūb) by way of the disconnected (munqaṭiʿ) or connected (muttaṣil) exception (قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil is "huwa" (الهمزة) for interrogation, (أسجد) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anā" (اللام) a preposition (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive (majrūr), attached to (أسجد) (خلقت) a past verb and its fāʿil (طينا) accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "from clay" [Note: al-ʿUkbarī allowed it to be a ḥāl (circumstantial) despite its being non-derived (jāmid), because of the meaning of origin it contains..].
The clause «قلنا ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «اسجدوا ...» is in the position of an accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «سجدوا ...» is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause قلنا.
The clause «قال ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أأسجد ...» is in the position of an accusative, the object of the saying.
The clause «خلقت ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).

safi-cedvel:62-67.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", i.e. Satan (الهمزة) for interrogation (رأيتك) a past verb and its fāʿil ... and (الكاف) is a particle of address [Note: See further detail in the i'rab of the parallel verse in Surat al-Anʿām, verse (40).], i.e. "tell me" (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh) (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, badal (substitute) of the demonstrative — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — (كرّمت) like رأيت (على) a preposition and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كرّمت) ... and the second object is an implied interrogative clause indicated by the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, i.e. why have You honoured him above me? (اللام) preparing for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam) (إن) a conditional particle that puts into the jussive (أخّرتن) a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (التاء) is a pronoun, fāʿil, and (النون) is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and (الياء), dropped for lightening, is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (إلى يوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخّرت) (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (اللام) the lām of oath (أحتنكنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is "anā" (ذرّيّته) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (إلّا) a particle of exception (قليلا) accusative by exception.
The clause «قال ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أرأيتك ...» is in the position of an accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كرّمت ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «أخّرت ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أحتنكنّ ...» has no grammatical position, the answer to the oath.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.
63- (قال) like the first, and the fāʿil is "huwa", i.e. Allah (اذهب) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "anta" (الفاء) a conjunction (من) a conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject) (تبعك) a past verb, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "huwa", and the verb is in the position of a jussive, the protasis (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent (الفاء) linking the apodosis (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb (جهنّم) the noun of إنّ, accusative, barred from tanwīn because of being a proper name and feminine (جزاؤكم) the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative..
and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (جزاء) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, its governor being the maṣdar (verbal noun) before it [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, its implied form being تجزون ("you will be recompensed").. al-ʿUkbarī allowed it to be a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl, and to be a tamyīz (specification).], (موفورا) naʿt (adjective) of جزاء, accusative.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «اذهب ...» is in the position of an accusative, the object of the saying.
The clause «من تبعك ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قال.
The clause «تبعك ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «إنّ جهنّم جزاؤكم ...» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
64- (الواو) resumptive (استفزز) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "anta" (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (استطعت) like كرّمت (منهم) like the first, attached to a ḥāl of the omitted resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid), i.e. whom you are able to provoke of them (بصوتك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استفزز).. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (الواو) a conjunction (اجلب) like استفزز (عليهم) like منهم, attached to (اجلب), (بخيلك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the agent of اجلب [Note: al-Jamal said in his marginal gloss: «In al-Mukhtār: جلب على فرسه يجلب جلبا, on the pattern طلب يطلب طلبا, means he shouted at it from behind and urged it on to race; and likewise أجلب عليه. This requires the bāʾ to be redundant, and the meaning on that basis is: urge on and hasten your troops against them, horsemen and footmen, so that you overtake them and gain mastery over them» end quote.].. and (الكاف) is like the last (الواو) a conjunction (رجلك) conjoined to خيلك and parsed like it (الواو) a conjunction (شاركهم) like استفزز.. and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (في الأموال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (شارك), (الواو) a conjunction (الأولاد) conjoined to الأموال, genitive (الواو) a conjunction (عدهم) like شاركهم (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) (ما) negating (يعدهم) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (هم) is mafʿūl bihi (الشيطان) fāʿil, nominative (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr) (غرورا) mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar because it is its adjective, i.e. except a deceptive promise [Note: See verse (120) of al-Nisāʾ and (112) of al-Anʿām.].
The clause «استفزز ...» has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «استطعت ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «اجلب ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause استفزز.
The clause «شاركهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause استفزز.
The clause «عدهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause استفزز.
The clause «يعدهم الشيطان ...» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl.
65- (إنّ عبادي) like إنّ جهنّم, and the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ ... and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi (ليس) a past defective verb, non-inflecting (jāmid) (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the khabar of ليس (عليهم) like منهم, attached to the khabar [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl of سلطان — an adjective that has come before the noun it qualifies —] (سلطان) the noun of ليس, nominative (الواو) a conjunction (كفى) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied fatḥa (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition (ربّك) genitive in form, nominative in position, the fāʿil of كفى.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (وكيلا) ḥāl, accusative [Note: or tamyīz, accusative.].
The clause «إنّ عبادي ليس لك ...» has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «ليس لك عليهم سلطان ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «كفى بربّك وكيلا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّ عبادي ...
66- (ربّكم) mubtadaʾ, nominative.. and (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, khabar (يزجي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied ḍamma on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is "huwa", which is the resumptive pronoun (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (يزجي) (الفلك) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (في البحر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يزجي) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl of الفلك.], (اللام) for giving the reason (taʿlīl) (تبتغوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (من فضله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تبتغوا), and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تبتغوا ...) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to (يزجي) (إنّه) a particle resembling the verb.. and (الهاء) is the noun of إنّ (كان) a past defective verb, its noun being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (بكم) like لكم, attached to (رحيما), which is the khabar of كان, accusative.
The clause «ربّكم الذي ...» has no grammatical position, a reason for the sufficiency of the power and an explanation of it.
The clause «يزجي لكم الفلك ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «تبتغوا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «إنّه كان بكم ...» has no grammatical position, a reason for His saying يزجي.
The clause «كان بكم رحيما ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
67- (الواو) a conjunction (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, attached to (ضلّ), (مسّكم) a past verb ... and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (الضرّ) fāʿil, nominative (في البحر) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl of the agent or of the object (ضلّ) a past verb (من) a relative noun, fāʿil, in the position of a nominative (تدعون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (إلّا) a particle of exception (إيّاه) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative by way of the disconnected (munqaṭiʿ) or connected (muttaṣil) exception (الفاء) a conjunction (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing the meaning of condition, attached to (أعرضتم), (نجّاكم) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied fatḥa.. and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "huwa" (إلى البرّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نجّاكم) by its being made to contain the meaning of أوصلكم ("brought you") (أعرضتم) a past verb and its fāʿil (الواو) resumptive (كان ... كفورا) like كان.. رحيما (الإنسان) the noun of كان, nominative.
The clause «مسّكم الضرّ ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ضلّ من تدعون ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تدعون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «نجّاكم ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أعرضتم ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of the condition (لمّا).
The clause «كان الإنسان كفورا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(موفورا): a passive participle from the triliteral وفر; its pattern is مفعول, and it has been used in the sense of the active participle, i.e. وافرا ("abundant"), in the manner of the rational figure (majāz ʿaqlī).
(رجلك): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning "footmen"; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then kasra, and the ʿayn may be made quiescent.
(عدهم): it contains a change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf); its past is وعد, an assimilated weak verb (mithāl) with kasra on the ʿayn in the imperfect, whose fāʾ is dropped in the imperfect and the imperative; its pattern is عل with kasra on the ʿayn.
(يعدهم): the change in it is of the same kind as the change in (عدهم).

* Rhetoric:
1- The loose figure (al-majāz al-mursal):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «أَرَأَيْتَكَ هذَا الَّذِي كَرَّمْتَ عَلَيَّ».
This is a figure in using "seeing" in the sense of "informing", so the meaning is: tell me about this one whom You have honoured above me — why have You honoured him above me when I am nobler than he? The relation is what lies between knowledge and informing, of cause and effect, and of the entailing and the entailed.
2- The representative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «وَأَجْلِبْ عَلَيْهِمْ بِخَيْلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ».
The verse represents the state of Satan: his provoking with his voice and his rallying of his horse and foot are a representation of his domination over whomever he leads astray, as though a raider fell upon a people, shouted at them with a shout that dislodged them from their places, and rallied against them his troops of horsemen and footmen until he uprooted them.
3- Shift of address (al-iltifāt):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «وَما يَعِدُهُمُ الشَّيْطانُ إِلَّا غُرُوراً».
Here there is a shift from the second person to the third. What the outward context required was to say: وما تعدهم إلا غرورا, but it turned away from that to strengthen the sense of the parenthesis, together with what it contains of turning the speech away from addressing him and explaining his state to people, and of intimating that his devilry is the cause of deception, which is the embellishing of error with what gives the impression that it is right.

* Benefits:
1- The mafʿūl muṭlaq is governed by one of four governors:
a- A maṣdar like it in wording and meaning, as in the verse.
b- Or a maṣdar in meaning but not in wording, as in:
«أعجبني إيمانك تصديقا» ("your faith, a believing, pleased me").
c- A verb derived from it: «وَكَلَّمَ اللَّهُ مُوسى تَكْلِيماً».
d- Or an active or passive participle used intensively, derived from its verb, as in: «وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا» or (الخبز مأكول أكلا) — the first is the intensive of the active participle, the second the intensive of the passive participle. The discussion will be completed in what is to come, Allah willing.
2- The prepared ḥāl (al-ḥāl al-muwaṭṭaʾa) is the non-derived (jāmid) noun that is mentioned and prepared for with a derived adjective so that it may be considered a ḥāl, as in: «فَتَمَثَّلَ لَها بَشَراً سَوِيًّا».
The explanation of that is: when the non-derived noun is qualified by what may be a ḥāl, it itself becomes valid as a ḥāl — so consider it carefully..!
3- The adverbial لمّا:
it is the one that means «حين ("when") or إذا» and requires two clauses whose verbs are both past.
It is in the accusative by its apodosis.
It is annexed to its first verb; in other words: the first clause is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of «لمّا» to it.
The verifying scholars hold that it is a means of linking two clauses, and for that reason they called it «the particle of existence for existence» (ḥarf wujūd li-wujūd).
That is, it indicates the existence of something because of the existence of something else. We may clarify it further in another place, Allah willing.

safi-cedvel:68-69.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for the interrogative of rebuke (istifhām tawbīkhī) (الفاء) resumptive [Note: According to the parsers it is a conjunction that conjoins the overt to something implied, i.e. were you saved from drowning and so felt secure..], (أمنتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn.. and (تم) is a pronoun, fāʿil (agent) (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative particle (نخسف) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the fāʿil is "naḥnu", for majesty (الباء) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of جانب البرّ [Note: The bāʾ may be causal, so it is attached to the verb نخسف.], (جانب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative [Note: Some allowed it to be an adverb.. with the object implied.], (البرّ) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; and the interpreted maṣdar (أن نخسف..) is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (الواو) a conjunction (نرسل عليكم حاصبا) like نخسف بكم جانب and conjoined to it (ثمّ) a conjunction (لا) negating (تجدوا) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to the accusative (نرسل), the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (لكم) like بكم, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (وكيلا) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «أمنتم ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «نخسف ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «نرسل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نخسف.
The clause «تجدوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نرسل.
69- (أم) it is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, meaning بل and the hamza (أمنتم أن نعيدكم) like أمنتم أن نخسف.. and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (نعيدكم), (تارة) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), for it is its synonym (أخرى) naʿt (adjective) of تارة, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نعيدكم..) is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (الفاء) a conjunction (نرسل عليكم قاصفا) like نرسل عليكم حاصبا, and the verb is conjoined to (نعيدكم), (من الريح) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of (قاصفا), (الفاء) a conjunction (يفرقكم) [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse has فيغرقكم, and the source itself uses يغرقكم below] an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to نرسل..
and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "huwa" (الباء) a causal preposition (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle (كفرتم) like أمنتم.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كفرتم..) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (يغرقكم) (ثمّ لا تجدوا لكم ... تبيعا) like ثمّ لا تجدوا لكم وكيلا, and the verb is conjoined to يغرقكم (على) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (تبيعا), (به) like بكم, attached to (تجدوا) [Note: It may be attached to (تبيعا), or to an omitted ḥāl of (تبيعا).].
The clause «أمنتم (the second) ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: (أم) may be the connected (muttaṣila) one, so the clause is conjoined to the first clause أمنتم.].
The clause «نعيدكم ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «نرسل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نعيدكم.
The clause «يغرقكم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نرسل.
The clause «كفرتم ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «لا تجدوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يغرقكم.

* Morphology:
(جانب): a noun meaning "side", in the form of the active participle; its pattern is فاعل.
(حاصبا): a noun meaning the wind or the cloud; it came in the form of the active participle of the verb حصبه, of the ضرب class, i.e. he pelted him with الحصباء, which are small stones.
(قاصفا): a noun for the violent wind that smashes things and breaks them; it came on the pattern فاعل from the triliteral قصف meaning "to break", of the ضرب class.
(تبيعا): a derived word; its pattern is فعيل in the sense of فاعل, and it is one who demands a right and persists in the demand.

safi-cedvel:70-70.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (اللام) the lām of oath for an implied oath (قد) a particle of verification (taḥqīq) (كرّمنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent) (بني) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ (آدم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa (الواو) a conjunction (حملناهم) like كرّمنا.. and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (في البرّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object pronoun (البحر) conjoined to البرّ by the wāw, genitive (الواو) a conjunction (رزقناهم) like حملناهم (من الطيّبات) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl of the object pronoun, i.e. "eating" [Note: It may be attached to (رزقناهم) by its being made to contain the meaning of أطعمناهم ("We fed them").], (الواو) a conjunction (فضّلناهم) "hum" حملناهم [Translator's note: so in the source, «هم حملناهم»; probably «مثل حملناهم», "like حملناهم", is meant.] (على كثير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فضّلنا), (من) a preposition (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of كثير (خلقنا) like كرّمنا (تفضيلا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative.
The clause «كرّمنا ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, the answer to the implied oath ... and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «حملناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كرّمنا.
The clause «رزقناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كرّمنا.
The clause «فضّلناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كرّمنا.
The clause «خلقنا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).

safi-cedvel:71-72.t:
* I'rab:
(يوم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر ("remember") [Note: or it is an adverb of time for an omitted verb explained by what follows, i.e. they will not be wronged on the day We call.], (ندعو) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw, and the fāʿil (agent) is "naḥnu", for majesty (كلّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) (أناس) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) (بإمامهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ندعو) [Note: or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. mingled with their leader.].. and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (الفاء) a conjunction (من) a conditional noun that puts into the jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject) (أوتي) a past verb, passive, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of a jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", and it is the resumptive pronoun (كتابه) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (بيمينه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أوتي), and (الهاء) is like the last (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) (أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ.. and (الكاف) is for address (يقرءون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (كتابهم) like كتابه (الواو) a conjunction (لا) negating (يظلمون) an imperfect verb, passive, nominative.. and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (فتيلا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), for it is its adjective.
The clause «(اذكر) يوم ندعو ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ندعو ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «من أوتي ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أوتي كتابه ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.].
The clause «أولئك يقرءون» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يقرءون ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «لا يظلمون ...» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause يقرءون.
72- (الواو) a conjunction (من) like the first (كان) a past defective verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of a jussive, the protasis, its noun being a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (في) a preposition (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh) (ذه) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (أعمى), which is the khabar of كان, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the implied fatḥa on the alif (الفاء) linking the apodosis (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (في الآخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the second (أعمى), which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied ḍamma on the alif (الواو) a conjunction (أضلّ) conjoined to the khabar أعمى, nominative (سبيلا) tamyīz (specification), accusative.
The clause «من كان ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من أوتي ...
The clause «كان ... أعمى» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «هو ... أعمى» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(أعمى): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb عمي يعمى, of the فرح class; its pattern is أفعل. The word may be an elative (ism tafḍīl), since the elative أضلّ comes after it..
See verse (60) of Surat al-Māʾida.

safi-cedvel:73-76.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (إن) lightened from the heavy [إنّ], necessarily inoperative (كادوا) a past defective verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the noun of كاد (اللام) it is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa) (يفتنون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent) and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (عن) a preposition (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يفتنون) by its being made to contain the meaning of يصرفونك ("they turn you away") (أوحينا) a past verb and its fāʿil (إلى) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (أوحينا), (اللام) for giving the reason (taʿlīl) (تفتري) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of reason, and the fāʿil is "anta" (على) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (تفتري), (غيره) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct)..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تفتري..) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to (يفتنونك).
(الواو) a conjunction (إذا) — with tanwīn — a particle of response with no governing effect (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of an implied condition [Note: i.e.: if you had done so, they would have taken you — as is mentioned after that — al-Jamal in his marginal gloss made it the lām of oath for an implied oath, but this usually requires (قد), as in the saying of Allah the Exalted: تالله لقد آثرك الله علينا.] (اتّخذوك) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (الكاف) is like the first in the verse (خليلا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «كادوا ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يفتنونك ...» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar (predicate) of كادوا.
The clause «أوحينا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «تفتري ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «اتّخذوك ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. if you had done that, they would have taken you as a close friend; and the condition clause has no grammatical position, conjoined to a resumptive clause.
74- (الواو) a conjunction (لولا) a conditional particle that does not put into the jussive (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle (ثبّتناك) like أوحينا.. and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لولا (قد) a particle of expectation — or of diminution (taqlīl) — (كدت) a past defective verb.. and (التاء) is a pronoun in the position of a nominative, the noun of كاد (تركن) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "anta" (إليهم) like إليك, attached to (تركن), (شيئا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative (قليلا) naʿt (adjective) of (شيئا), accusative..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن ثبّتناك..) is in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar is necessarily omitted, its implied form being موجود ("existing").
The clause «لولا تثبيتنا أيّاك بالعصمة ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كادوا.
The clause «ثبّتناك ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «كدت تركن ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تركن ...» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كدت.
75- (إذا لأذقناك) like إذا لاتّخذوك (ضعف) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (الحياة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and in the speech there is the omission of a muḍāf, i.e.: double the punishment of life (الواو) a conjunction (ضعف الممات) like ضعف الحياة and conjoined to it (ثمّ) a conjunction (لا) negating (تجد) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "anta" (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted second object (على) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (نصيرا), which is the first mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «أذقناك ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if you had done — or inclined — We would have made you taste..
The clause «لا تجد ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أذقناك.
76- (الواو) a conjunction (إن كادوا ليستفزّونك من الأرض) like إن كادوا ليفتنونك عن الذي.. (اللام) for giving the reason (يخرجوك) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (الكاف) is mafʿūl bihi (من) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (يخرجوك)..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخرجوك..) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to (يستفزّونك).
(الواو) a conjunction (إذا) with tanwīn, like the first (لا) negating (يلبثون) like يفتنون (خلافك) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يلبثون), and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr) (قليلا) standing in for the maṣdar, mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative [Note: or standing in for the adverb, i.e. except a little time.].
The clause «إن كادوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the first clause كادوا.
The clause «يستفزّونك ...» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كادوا.
The clause «يلبثون ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. if they had expelled you, they would not remain ... and the implied condition clause has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إن كادوا (the second).

* Morphology:
(خليلا): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from خلّه, i.e. his sincere friend; the adjective has come from a non-triliteral anomalously (shudhūdhan); its pattern is فعيل.
(أذقناك): it contains a change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf) suiting its being built on sukūn; its original form is أذاقناك, and when two quiescent letters met, the alif — the ʿayn of the verb — was dropped, because it is a hollow weak verb; its pattern is أفلناك.

* Rhetoric:
1- Exaggeration in diminishing the near-occurrence (al-kaydūda):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «وَإِنْ كادُوا لَيَفْتِنُونَكَ».
In this noble verse there is exaggeration in diminishing the near-occurrence, because the mere gentleness that policy and winning over the people required was held against the Prophet ﷺ, since a sin grows great in proportion to the one who commits it, according to what has come down: «the good deeds of the pious are the bad deeds of those brought near».
2- Ellipsis (al-ḥadhf):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «لَأَذَقْناكَ ضِعْفَ الْحَياةِ وَضِعْفَ الْمَماتِ».
The original form of the speech is: We would have made you taste a doubled punishment in life and a doubled punishment in death. Then the qualified noun was omitted and the adjective, which is "double", was put in its place. Then the adjective was annexed as the qualified noun would be annexed, so it was said: ضعف الحياة، وضعف الممات, as though it were said:
لأذقناك أليم الحياة وأليم الممات.

* Benefits:
1- The Messenger's stance towards Thaqīf.
History tells us that Thaqīf asked the Messenger ﷺ to single them out with things they could boast of over the Arabs; among them was their saying: that we not pay the tithe, nor be mustered, nor bow down in our prayer; that every usury owed to us is ours, and every usury owed by us is remitted from us; that you let us enjoy al-Lāt for a year, so that we may take what is offered to it, and when we have taken it we will break it and embrace Islam; and that you make our valley sacred as Mecca was made sacred; and if the Arabs say: why did you do that, then say: Allah commanded me to. They brought their document, and he wrote: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. This is a document from Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, to Thaqīf: they shall not be tithed and shall not be mustered. They said: nor bow down (ولا يحبّون) [Translator's note: so spelled in the source here and below; يجبّون, as in نجبّي above, is meant].
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was silent. Then they said to the scribe: write «لا يحبّون», and the scribe was looking at the Messenger of Allah. Then ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb stood up, drew his sword and said: You have inflamed the heart of our Prophet — O people of Thaqīf — may Allah inflame your hearts with fire! They said: we are not speaking to you, we are only speaking to Muhammad. That was the cause of the revelation of the verses mentioned.
Of course: لا نعشر means: a tenth of our wealth is not taken from us. ولا نحشر means: we are not driven out to jihad.
ولا نجبّي في صلاتنا means: they do not bow or prostrate.
In one narration, they asked to be exempted from prayer. The Messenger granted them the first two requests, but said: there is no good in a religion in which there is no bowing and prostrating — or as he said.
It is natural that these verses annulled the agreement that Thaqīf tried to dictate to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and defined the position of Islam towards them and those like them. Further, we must take up in the discussion the verb كاد, for it is repeated in these verses several times.
Ibn Hishām has an enjoyable discussion of this verb, in which he refutes some grammarians and parsers on some of what they became known for, including their saying: that «كاد» — its affirmation is negation and its negation is affirmation; so if it is said: كاد يفعل, its meaning is that he did not do it, and if it is said: لم يكد يفعل, its meaning is that he did it. al-Maʿmarī [Translator's note: so in the source, «المعمري»] went to the like of that in a discussion we can dispense with recounting, for fear of lengthiness. What is correct is that its ruling is the ruling of all other verbs: its negation is negation and its affirmation is affirmation, as is shown by its meaning being approximation; so «كاد يفعل» means he came near to doing it, and «ما كاد يفعل» means he did not come near to doing it. An example of that is «إذا أخرج يده لم يكد يراها». So reflect and consider — may Allah inspire you with right guidance..!

safi-cedvel:77-77.t:
* I'rab:
(سنّة) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, the implied sense being: سنّنا ذلك سنّة ("We made that a practice") [Note: It may be a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اتّبع ("follow").. al-Farrāʾ allowed its accusative to be by removal of the preposition, i.e.: like the practice of Allah regarding those We have sent, with the preposition attached to (يستفزّونك) or to (لا يلبثون) in the preceding [verse].], (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (قد) a particle of verification (taḥqīq) (أرسلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent) (قبلك) an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أرسلنا), and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (من رسلنا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted object of أرسلنا, i.e. We sent him from among Our messengers (الواو) a conjunction (لا تجد.. تحويلا) like لا تجد.. نصيرا [Note: in verse (75) of this sura.], (لسنّتنا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi, and (نا) is muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قد أرسلنا ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «لا تجد ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the implied clause سنّنا.

safi-cedvel:78-81.t:
* I'rab:
(أقم) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta" (الصلاة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) (لدلوك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أقم) [Note: This lām means "after", i.e. after the declining of the sun, as in their saying كتبته لثلاث خلون ("I wrote it after three [nights] had passed"); and it may be for giving the reason, i.e. for the sake of the declining of the sun or because of the declining of the sun.], (الشمس) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) (إلى غسق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أقم) [Note: It may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الصلاة, i.e. continuing..], (الليل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (الواو) a conjunction (قرآن) conjoined to الصلاة, accusative [Note: or it is a mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being أقم or الزم ("hold to"), and the conjoining is then a conjoining of clauses.], (الفجر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative (قرآن) the noun of إنّ, accusative (الفجر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (كان) a past defective verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — its noun being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (مشهودا) the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative.
The clause «أقم ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إنّ قرآن الفجر ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «كان مشهودا» is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar of إنّ.
79- (الواو) a conjunction (من الليل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being اسهر من الليل ("stay awake part of the night") [Note: (من) here is either partitive, i.e. a part of the night, or in the sense of (في), i.e. stay awake in the night, or stand in the night.], (الفاء) a conjunction (تهجّد) like (أقم) (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (تهجّد), and the pronoun refers to the Quran [Note: i.e. pray the night vigil with the Quran, so التهجّد means prayer.. or the pronoun refers to the night, i.e. stay awake in the night.] (نافلة) ḥāl, accusative, of the omitted object, i.e. pray the night vigil in the state of its being supererogatory [Note: It may be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun) because it has its meaning, i.e. perform it as a supererogatory act; and if التهجّد is explained as prayer, (نافلة) is a mafʿūl bihi.], (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (نافلة) (عسى) a complete (tāmm) past verb (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative particle (يبعثك) an imperfect verb, accusative.. and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (ربّك) fāʿil, nominative.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (مقاما) ḥāl, accusative, with an implied muḍāf, i.e. "possessing a station" [Note: It may be a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, i.e. you will stand a standing; and it may be an adverb attached to (يبعثك).], (محمودا) naʿt (adjective) of (مقاما), accusative..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبعثك..) is in the position of a nominative, the fāʿil of عسى.
The clause «(اسهر) من الليل» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أقم..
The clause «تهجّد ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (اسهر).
The clause «عسى أن يبعثك» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or giving the reason —.
The clause «يبعثك ربّك ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
80- (الواو) a conjunction (قل) like أقم (ربّ) the one addressed (munādā), annexed, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ that was dropped for lightening.. and the dropped (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi (أدخلني) an imperative verb, and (النون) is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and (الياء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "anta", and the second object of أدخلني is omitted, its implied form being "Medina" (مدخل) mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative (صدق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (الواو) a conjunction (أخرجني مخرج صدق) like its counterpart preceding it (الواو) a conjunction (اجعل) like أدخل (اللام) a preposition and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (من لدنك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the second object.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (سلطانا) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative (نصيرا) naʿt of (سلطانا), accusative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تهجّد.
The clause of «the vocative and its answer ...» is in the position of an accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أدخلني ...» has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أخرجني ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أدخلني.
The clause «اجعل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أدخلني.
81- (الواو) a conjunction (قل) like the previous (جاء) a past verb (الحقّ) fāʿil, nominative (الواو) a conjunction (زهق الباطل) like جاء الحقّ (إنّ الباطل كان زهوقا) like إنّ قرآن الفجر كان مشهودا.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قل (the first).
The clause «جاء الحقّ ...» is in the position of an accusative, the object of the saying.
The clause «زهق الباطل ...» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause جاء الحقّ.
The clause «إنّ الباطل كان ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason.
The clause «كان زهوقا» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(دلوك): the maṣdar of the verb دلكت الشمس دلوكا, of the نصر class, i.e. it passed the meridian or inclined towards setting; according to al-Zamakhsharī it is derived from الدلك ("rubbing"), because a person rubs his eyes when looking at the sun; its pattern is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(غسق): the maṣdar of the triliteral verb غسق يغسق الليل, of the ضرب class, i.e. its darkness intensified; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.
(نافلة): a noun for the prayer in addition to the obligatory one, on the pattern فاعلة.
(مقاما): it may be meant as the mīm-maṣdar (maṣdar mīmī) of the triliteral قام, and it may be meant as the noun of place.. see verse (125) of al-Baqara.
(محمودا): a passive participle from the triliteral حمد, on the pattern مفعول.
(مدخل): a mīm-maṣdar from the quadriliteral أدخل; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(مخرج): a mīm-maṣdar from the quadriliteral أخرج; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(زهوقا): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the triliteral زهق يزهق, of the فتح class, meaning "it dwindled and vanished"; it may be an intensive form of the active participle; its pattern is فعول with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
1- The loose figure (al-majāz al-mursal):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «وَقُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ».
The part is used for the whole, i.e. the recitation of dawn, and what is meant by it is the prayer, because recitation is part of it; so the relation is partiality (juzʾiyya).
2- Using the overt noun where a pronoun was expected (al-iẓhār fī maqām al-iḍmār):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «إِنَّ قُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ كانَ مَشْهُوداً» after His saying: «وَقُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ».
The overt noun occurs where a pronoun was expected, and He, glory be to Him, did not say إنه, for greater emphasis and attention.
3- The subtle antithesis (al-muqābala al-laṭīfa):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ» and «أَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ», and between «جاءَ الْحَقُّ» and «وَزَهَقَ الْباطِلُ».
4- On the tail-clause (al-tadhyīl):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «وَقُلْ جاءَ الْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الْباطِلُ إِنَّ الْباطِلَ كانَ زَهُوقاً».
This device is: that the poet or prose writer appends to his speech, after it is complete and it is fine to stop on it, a clause that verifies the speech before it, adds emphasis to it, and runs in it like a proverb, for greater verification.
This verse is among the greatest examples of it: the last clause is the tadhyīl that came out in the form of a current proverb.

* Benefits:
1- The noun of place and the noun of time.
1- They are two nouns formed for the time of the occurrence of the action or its place:
2- They are formed from the triliteral whose imperfect has ḍamma or fatḥa on the ʿayn on the pattern «مفعل» [Translator's note: i.e. with fatḥa on the ʿayn], and likewise when the verb is weak in the lām, as in مرمى and مسعى.
3- They are formed from the triliteral, when it has kasra on the ʿayn, or is assimilated (mithāl), on the pattern «مفعل» [Translator's note: i.e. with kasra on the ʿayn], as in مجلس, موعد and ميسر.
4- Excepted from those with ḍamma on the ʿayn are eleven words that came with kasra, namely:
منسك ومطلع ومشرق ومغرب ومرفق ومفرق ومجزر ومنبت ومسقط ومسكن ومسجد.
